secondary.description: An array of WAN interface label IDs to use as the secondary WAN ports this overlay.

PausedApplianceList.description: List of appliance network element primary keys (nePks) that are paused from orchestration.

PeerConfig.description: Priority configuration for a single peer appliance.

peer_metric.description: Advertised metric value for this peer. Lower values indicate higher priority for traffic routing.

peer_weight.description: Weight value assigned to the peer for traffic distribution. Higher weights receive proportionally more traffic.

self.description: Indicates whether this entry represents the local appliance itself. Values: 'true' for local, 'false' for remote peer.

PeerList.description: A map of peer names to their priority configuration. Keys are dynamic peer name strings.

PeerPriorityResponse.description: Response containing the peer priority configuration.

PortForwardingEntry.description: Represents a single port forwarding rule defining how inbound packets are translated (DNAT). Matches incoming traffic by source/destination criteria and redirects to target IP/port.

srcSubnet.description: Source subnet in CIDR notation that traffic must originate from to match this rule. Use '0.0.0.0/0' to match any source.

destSubnet.description: Destination subnet in CIDR notation that incoming packets must match. Typically the appliance's public-facing IP with /32 mask.

destPort.description: Destination port or port range to match. Single port (e.g., '80') or range (e.g., '8000-8100'). Use '0' for ICMP protocol.

protocol.description: IP protocol to match. Supported values: TCP, UDP, ICMP.

targetIp.description: Internal destination IP address. Matched packets have their destination IP translated to this address.

targetPort.description: Internal destination port or port range. Matched packets have their destination port translated to this value.

gms_marked.description: Indicates rule origin. True if auto-generated by Orchestrator (GMS), false if manually created by user.

comment.description: User-defined description or note for the rule. Useful for documenting rule purpose.

vrf_id.description: VRF segment identifier for the rule. Default value is 0 (Default segment). Used for multi-tenant or segmented network configurations.

srcIf.description: Source interface name to constrain rule matching. Empty string matches traffic from any interface.

behindNAT.description: Determines if this interface is connected to a Network Address Translation device (only applicable to WAN interfaces). Valid values are 'auto', 'none', ''. 'auto' means interface is behind a NAT device. 'none' or '' mean interface is NOT behind a NAT device

comment.description: User comments

dhcp.description: Determines if DHCP is enabled for this interface (only applicable for WAN side main interface IPs in inline router mode).

dhcpd.description: Interface DHCP (server/relay) configuration (only applicable to LAN interfaces in inline router mode)

harden.description: Determines if this interface has firewall configured (only applicable for WAN side main/VLAN interfaces in router mode). Valid values are 0:Allow All, 1:Hardened, 2:Stateful, 3:Stateful+SNAT

ip.description: Appliance interface IP address

label.description: Determines which interface label name is assigned to this interface. If empty that means no label is assigned.

lanSide.description: Determines if this interface is on LAN side.

maxBW.description: Maximum inbound/outbound bandwidth for this interface in Kbps (only applicable to WAN interfaces)

vrf.description: VRF segment id assigned to this interface. 0 if no VRF segment assigned

wanSide.description: Determines if this interface is on WAN side.

zone.description: Zone id assigned to this interface. 0 if no zone assigned

portProfilesDhcpFailover.description: List of dhcp failover settings configured on the interfaces

(ifname).description: Configuration for dhcp failover per interface

intf.description: Interface name for this route entry, auto or bvi0/bvi1/VLAN for bridge mode

metric.description: Routing metric value, lower values have higher priority

nexthop.description: Next hop IP address for this route entry

type.description: Route entry type, gw is the only option for now

(licenseType).description: This key is dynamic based on the EC license type (fx, ecsp etc). Contains additional details based on license type.

ecBoost.description: Is EC WAN Optimization (i.e. boost) license enabled

ecBoostBW.description: WAN Optimization (i.e. boost) bandwidth in Kbps

load_bal_max.description: Defines a threshold to compare with the secs field of the client's DHCP packet in order to override load balancing.

max_resp_delay.description: Tells the DHCP server how many seconds may pass without receiving a message from its failover peer before it assumes that connection has failed.

max_unack_updates.description: Tells the remote DHCP server how many BNDUPD messages it can send before it receives a BNDACK from the local system.

mclt.description: Define the Maximum Client Lead Time.

my_ip.description: Define the address that the server should listen for connections from its failover peer

my_port.description: Defines which TCP port the server should listen for connections from its failover peer.

peer_ip.description: Define which server it should connect to reach its failover peer.

peer_port.description: Define which TCP port to connect to its failover peer for failover messages.

role.description: Specify if the server is the primary or secondary.

split.description: Specify the split between the primary and secondary

portProfilesLabelInUseGetResp.description: Response indicating whether an interface label is in use and which deployment profiles use it.

inUse.description: True if the label is used by at least one deployment profile, false otherwise.

portProfileIds.description: List of deployment profile IDs that use this interface label. Empty array if label is not in use.

items.description: UUID of a deployment profile using this label.

devNum.description: Deployment interface type - rtr1/rtr2, bdg1/bdg2, for UI use, not needed in POST

ifName.description: Deployment interface name - wan0/lan0 for router mode, bvi0/bvi1 for bridge mode

id.description: System generated unique identifier for the Deployment Profile, leave empty or null when creating new Deployment Profile template

name.description: Deployment Profile template name

bonding.description: Use interface bonding (only valid for models with 2 LAN interfaces and 2 WAN interfaces)

haIf.description: Name of the interface used to build 'internal' High Availability (HA) VLAN interfaces using which two appliances in a HA configuration can communicate with each other

inline.description: Inline router mode (only valid for router mode). This is the recommended mode.

licence.description: Appliance EC license information (only valid for EC models)

maxInBW.description: System maximum inbound bandwidth in Kbps (to enable inbound shaping, make sure the "Enable shaping" checkbox is selected in the Shaper settings)

mode.description: System deployment mode

propagateLinkDown.description: Propagate link down state: this is valid in bridge mode only. If it is true, if either LAN or WAN side interface of the bridge is down, the system brings down the other interface automatically

singleBridge.description: Single 4-port flat bridge configuration (only valid for 4-port models)

tenG.description: Use 10Gbps interfaces (only valid for models with 10Gbps interfaces)

useMgmt0.description: Use mgmt0 interface as a datapath interface as well. (only valid under router mode)

items.description: Available VRF Segments
Available Zones

serverPerSegment.description: Determine Common/Distinct DHCP server per segment

prio.description: Priority rules map. Keys are priority numbers (lower values = higher priority).

gms_marked.description: Flag indicating if this rule was created/managed by Orchestrator.

acl.description: Access Control List name to match against.

dst_ip.description: Destination IP address or CIDR to match.

either_ip.description: Match if IP appears as source or destination.

dst_port.description: Destination port or port range to match.

src_dns.description: Source DNS name pattern to match.

dst_dns.description: Destination DNS name pattern to match.

src_geo.description: Source geographic location (country code) to match.

dst_geo.description: Destination geographic location (country code) to match.

either_service.description: Match if service appears as source or destination.

LegacyApiEntry.description: Represents a legacy API path transformation entry that maps deprecated API paths to new endpoints.

id.description: Auto-generated unique identifier for the legacy API entry. Read-only on output.

newMethod.description: HTTP method for the new API endpoint (e.g., GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

body.description: Indicates legacy request body field name for nePks list transformation. Empty string if no transformation needed.

LegacyApiPostRequest.description: Request body for creating a new legacy API transformation entry. Defines the mapping from a deprecated API endpoint to its new equivalent.

newMethod.description: Target HTTP method for the new API endpoint. The incoming request will be transformed to use this method.

newPath.description: Target URL path for the new API. Supports {param} placeholders that are populated from regex capture groups via the params field.

oldMethod.description: HTTP method of the legacy/deprecated API that triggers this transformation when matched with the pattern.

newMethod.description: Target HTTP method for the transformed request. Replaces the existing value.

newPath.description: Target URL path for the new API. Supports {param} placeholders populated from regex capture groups.

oldMethod.description: HTTP method of the legacy API that triggers this transformation.

pattern.description: Java regex pattern to match legacy API paths. Capture groups () extract path parameters.

params.description: JSON object string mapping placeholder names to capture group indices (1-based).

body.description: Field name for body transformation. Empty string for no transformation.

RealTimeStats.description: Request body specifying which real-time statistic to retrieve. The 'type' determines which metric category, 'name' identifies the specific resource, and 'filter' (when required) specifies traffic type or direction.

type.description: Statistics category. Determines valid 'name' and 'filter' values. Note: 'app' type removed in Orchestrator 9.3.0.

x-enum-descriptions.tunnel: Per-tunnel or pass-through bandwidth/MOS stats. Filter not required.
x-enum-descriptions.trafficType: Aggregate optimized or all-traffic stats. Filter not required.
x-enum-descriptions.flow: TCP accelerated/unaccelerated or non-TCP flow stats. Filter required.
x-enum-descriptions.dscp: Per-DSCP value (0-63) traffic stats. Filter required.
x-enum-descriptions.shaper: QoS shaper stats per traffic class. Filter specifies direction.
x-enum-descriptions.drops: Global packet drop statistics. Name must be empty string.

name.description: Resource identifier. Value interpretation depends on 'type'.

x-value-mapping.tunnel: Tunnel name (e.g., 'datacenter_tunnel'), 'pass-through', 'pass-through-unshaped', or tunnel ID for MOS
x-value-mapping.trafficType: '0' for optimized traffic, '3' for all traffic
x-value-mapping.trafficClass: Traffic class as string: '0' to '9' (0=highest priority)

filter.description: Traffic type filter or direction (string). Required for: dscp, trafficClass, flow, interface. For shaper: direction filter. Ignored for: tunnel, trafficType, drops.

RealTimeStatsResponse.description: Time-series statistics response. Each property is a metric name containing an array of [timestamp, value] pairs. Returns data for the last 3 seconds (up to 3 data points per metric). Note: For type=drops, property keys are numeric drop reason codes (e.g., '78', '169') and timestamps are in microseconds. For other types, timestamps are in Unix seconds. See x-drop-reason-codes for the complete code-to-description mapping.

additionalProperties.description: Array of measurement tuples. Each tuple is [timestamp, metric_value]. Timestamp units vary by type: microseconds for drops, seconds for other types.

items.description: Single measurement: [timestamp, value].

x-common-metrics.drops: Keys are numeric reason codes. See x-drop-reason-codes for complete mapping.

x-flow-aggregation.description: To get total flows created per second across all flow types
x-flow-aggregation.algorithm: Call API 3 times with name='0','1','2'. Each response has CREATED:[[ts1,v1],[ts2,v2],[ts3,v3]]. Sum CREATED values per-timestamp across all 3 responses, then report MAX of those sums as peak flows/sec.

success.description: Indicates whether the operation succeeded on this Stats Collector.

message.description: Human-readable message describing the result or error.

example.message: Job deleted successfully

TargetAppliance.description: Specifies target appliances for job execution (applicable to appliance-specific jobs).

appliances.description: List of appliance identifiers targeted by this job.

groups.description: List of appliance group identifiers targeted by this job.

TargetApplianceHistorical.description: Target appliances for the job, resolved to IP addresses and hostnames

groups.description: List of appliance groups targeted by the job

regions.description: List of regions targeted by the job

appliances.description: List of individual appliances targeted by the job

TimeOfDay.description: Time of day for scheduled execution.

TriggerDebug.description: Debug information for a job trigger

name.description: Name of the trigger in the Quartz scheduler

group.description: Group name of the trigger

cron.description: Cron expression for cron-based triggers (null for simple triggers)

repeatInterval.description: Repeat interval in milliseconds for simple triggers (0 for cron triggers)

timesTriggered.description: Number of times this trigger has fired

startTimeInSec.description: Trigger start time in Unix epoch seconds

startTimeAsString.description: Human-readable start time with timezone (e.g., '2023-01-01 00:00:00 UTC')

endTimeInSec.description: Trigger end time in Unix epoch seconds (0 if no end time set)

endTimeAsString.description: Human-readable end time with timezone (null if no end time set)

nextFireTime.description: Next scheduled fire time in Unix epoch seconds

nextFireTimeAsString.description: Human-readable next fire time with timezone

previousFireTime.description: Previous fire time in Unix epoch seconds (0 if never fired)

previousFireTimeAsString.description: Human-readable previous fire time with timezone (null if never fired)

daysOfTheWeek.description: Days of week to execute: 1=Sunday through 7=Saturday.

YearlyRecurrence.description: Yearly rotation schedule. Use type1 or type2 to specify the pattern.

type1.description: Specific month and day every year.

type2.description: Nth weekday of a specific month every year.

cronInfo.description: Cron expression details for job scheduling. Defines the recurrence pattern using Quartz cron syntax.

cronExpression.description: Quartz cron expression representing the job schedule (e.g., '0 0 2 * * ?' for daily at 2 AM).

recurrenceDefinedAsCron.description: True if the recurrence pattern can be expressed as a standard cron expression.

recurringSchedule.description: True if the job runs on a recurring schedule, false for one-time jobs.

reportViewport.description: Map of report chart type names to their display dimensions. Each key represents a specific chart type used in scheduled reports.

Appliance Packet Counts.description: Dimensions for packet count summary charts.

Application Bandwidth.description: Dimensions for per-application bandwidth usage charts.

Appliance BW Trends.description: Dimensions for appliance bandwidth trend charts over time.

Boost.description: Dimensions for Boost license utilization charts.

Countries.description: Dimensions for geographic country-based traffic charts.

DRC Bandwidth trends.description: Dimensions for Data Reduction Compression bandwidth trend charts.

DSCP Bandwidth.description: Dimensions for DSCP-based bandwidth distribution charts.

DSCP Pie Charts.description: Dimensions for DSCP distribution pie charts.

DSCP BW Trends.description: Dimensions for DSCP bandwidth trend charts over time.

Domains.description: Dimensions for domain traffic distribution charts.

Health Map.description: Dimensions for network health map visualization.

Interface BW Trends.description: Dimensions for interface bandwidth trend charts.

Jitter Trends.description: Dimensions for jitter trend charts over time.

Latency Trends.description: Dimensions for latency trend charts over time.

Loss.description: Dimensions for packet loss measurement charts.

Loss Trends.description: Dimensions for packet loss trend charts over time.

MOS.description: Dimensions for Mean Opinion Score quality charts.

MOS Trends.description: Dimensions for MOS trend charts over time.

Out of Order Packets.description: Dimensions for out-of-order packet count charts.

Out of Order Packets Trends.description: Dimensions for out-of-order packet trend charts over time.

Ports.description: Dimensions for port-based traffic distribution charts.

Shaper Trends.description: Dimensions for traffic shaper trend charts.

Top Talkers.description: Dimensions for top talkers traffic charts.

Traffic Class Bandwidth.description: Dimensions for traffic class bandwidth charts.

Traffic Class Pie Charts.description: Dimensions for traffic class distribution pie charts.

Tunnel Bandwidth.description: Dimensions for tunnel bandwidth usage charts.

Tunnel Bandwidth Pie Charts.description: Dimensions for tunnel bandwidth distribution pie charts.

Tunnel BW Trends.description: Dimensions for tunnel bandwidth trend charts over time.

Tunnel Flow Counts.description: Dimensions for tunnel flow count charts.

Tunnel Packet Counts.description: Dimensions for tunnel packet count charts.

targetAppliance.description: Specifies which appliances or groups the job will target.

groupPks.description: Array of group primary keys. Job runs on all appliances in these groups.

regionPks.description: Array of region primary keys. Job runs on appliances in these regions.

SecureWebServicesConfigResponse.description: Response object containing secure web services configuration and WebCC support status.

isWebccSupported.description: Indicates whether the appliance supports Web Content Classification (WebCC) feature.

ipReputationConfig.description: IP Reputation configuration settings for the appliance.

hasIPReputation.description: Indicates whether IP Reputation feature is enabled on the appliance.

incrementalUpdate.description: Indicates whether the appliance is configured to receive real-time incremental updates for IP reputation data.

secureWebServicesConfigEntry.description: Secure Web Services configuration containing URL classification and IP reputation settings.

hasSecureWebServicesConfig.description: Indicates whether Secure Web Services is enabled on the appliance. True if either URL classification or IP reputation is enabled.

urlClassificationConfigObj.description: URL Classification configuration settings for the appliance.

hasURLClassification.description: Indicates whether URL Classification feature is enabled on the appliance.

queryOnMiss.description: Indicates whether the appliance should perform cloud/network queries when a URL is not found in local cache.

incrementalUpdate.description: Indicates whether the appliance is configured to receive real-time incremental updates for URL classification data.

urlReputation.description: Reputation threshold ID for URL filtering. Determines minimum reputation score required for URLs.

urlIpLookUpResponse.description: Response object containing URL or IP lookup results from BrightCloud service.

type.description: Indicates the type of input (url or ip) that was looked up.

results.description: Array containing lookup results with classification and reputation information.

urlipQueries.description: Individual lookup result containing URL/IP and associated query results.

url.description: The URL or IP address that was looked up.

queries.description: Object containing combined results from getinfo and getrepinfo BrightCloud API queries.

getrepinfo.description: Reputation information for the URL/IP from BrightCloud.

reputation.description: Reputation score of the URL/IP. Higher values indicate better reputation (0-100 scale).

country.description: Two-letter country code where the URL/IP is hosted.

popularity.description: Popularity score indicating how frequently the URL/IP is accessed (0-100 scale).

age.description: Age of the domain/IP in days since first seen.

threathistory.description: Threat history indicator. 0 indicates no known threats, higher values indicate past malicious activity.

getinfo.description: Classification information for the URL/IP from BrightCloud.

a1cat.description: Primary category ID for the URL/IP classification.

reputation.description: Reputation score from classification query (0-100 scale).

cats.description: Array of category IDs that apply to the URL/IP.

WebCategoryEntry.description: A single web category entry containing its numeric ID, human-readable name, and classification group memberships.

id.description: Numeric identifier for the web category as used in match-criteria webcc_cat field (pipe-separated list of IDs).

name.description: Human-readable display name of the web category.

categories.description: List of classification group names this category belongs to. Possible values are 'strict' and 'moderate'. An empty array means the category is not part of any predefined group.

SecMapPriorities.description: Map of security policy rules keyed by priority number. Lower numbers have higher priority.

SecMapPriority.description: Defines a single security policy rule with match criteria and action.

comment.description: User-provided description for this rule.

gms_marked.description: Internal flag indicating this rule was created by Orchestrator. Do not modify.

match.description: Object containing traffic matching criteria (src_ip, dst_ip, protocol, ports, application, etc.).

misc.description: Miscellaneous settings including tag, rule name, logging, and logging_priority.

set.description: Action to apply when traffic matches. Contains 'action' field with value 'allow' or 'deny'.

SecurityMap.description: Contains prioritized security policy rules for a specific zone-to-zone mapping.

SecurityMapContainer.description: Container for zone-pair security maps. Each key represents a zone-to-zone traffic flow (format: '<fromZoneId>_<toZoneId>').

self.description: Self-reference identifier for the map container.

SecurityMapsResponse.description: Root object containing all security policy map configurations.

AdvancedSecuritySettingsClass.description: Advanced security settings configuration that controls certificate verification, CSRF protection, and binary integrity checks for Orchestrator and appliances.

enforceBinaryCheck.description: When enabled, enforces binary integrity verification during appliance boot. Ensures software binaries have not been tampered with.

enforceCSRFCheck.description: When enabled, enforces Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) token validation on both appliances and Orchestrator API requests.

verifyOrchestratorCert.description: When enabled, appliances verify the Orchestrator's SSL/TLS certificate before establishing connections. Disabled for CC mode appliances.

verifyPortalCert.description: When enabled, appliances verify the HPE Aruba Networking EdgeConnect Cloud Portal certificate. Changing this triggers portal WebSocket reconnection.

enable.description: Enable or Disable Protection Profile

tid.description: Object to hold Threshold field like classifacion, metric, protocol etc.

embryonic_time.description: Embryonic TCP duration time in sec. range 20-45 sec.

embryonic_non_tcp_time.description: Embryonic Non TCP duration time in sec. range 1-3600 sec.

preset_threshold_type.description: preset threshold type used in orchestrator

comment.description: Comment

items.description: List of profiles
Protection Profile zone_id & profile_name mapping

enable.description: Enable or Disable threshold

is_custom_type.description: used for marking threshold as custom type

ClearPassServiceStatus.description: Enumeration of possible service status values for ClearPass integration endpoints.

x-enum-descriptions.0: CREATING - Service endpoint is being provisioned
x-enum-descriptions.1: CREATED - Service endpoint is successfully created and operational
x-enum-descriptions.2: AUTH_FAILED - Authentication with ClearPass server failed
x-enum-descriptions.3: UNREACHABLE - ClearPass server is not reachable

SampleServiceSet.description: Map of service IDs to Service objects. Keys are unique service identifiers.

Service.description: A service configuration for routing internet traffic through pass-through tunnels.

name.description: Display name of the service. Must be unique and cannot contain commas.

img.description: Path to the service icon image for UI display.

peerName.description: Peer name of the pass-through tunnel for routing traffic.

enabled.description: Whether the service is currently enabled and available for use.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service.

ThirdPartyService.description: A third party cloud service for routing traffic through orchestrated tunnels. Built-in services (Zscaler, Netskope, HPE SSE) have their enabled status dynamically determined by subscription.

name.description: Display name of the third party service shown in the UI.

img.description: Path to the service icon image relative to web root.

peerName.description: Peer name pattern for tunnel matching. Supports wildcards (*) for dynamic tunnel association.

enabled.description: Whether the service is enabled. For built-in services (sp_zscaler, sp_netskope, sp_axis), this is dynamically set based on subscription status. For custom services, defaults to false if null.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service. Built-in services use predefined IDs (sp_zscaler, sp_netskope, sp_axis). Custom services use numeric IDs.

ThirdPartyServiceMap.description: Map of third party service keys to ThirdPartyService objects. Built-in services use keys like 'sp_zscaler', 'sp_netskope', 'sp_axis'. Custom services use 'sp_service{id}' pattern.

SessionGetItem.description: Represents an active user session with login details, timestamps, and session type indicators.

userName.description: Username of the authenticated user for this session.

loggedInTime.description: Timestamp (Unix epoch in milliseconds) when the user logged in.

lastInteractionTime.description: Timestamp (Unix epoch in milliseconds) of the user's last interaction with the system.

lastAccessTime.description: Timestamp (Unix epoch in milliseconds) of the user's last access. Used for session timeout calculations.

webClient.description: Indicates if the session originated from a web client. Always true for REST API sessions.

role.description: User's assigned role determining access permissions. May be 'net_read' for read-only access on HA backup Orchestrators.

isMtoSsoSession.description: Indicates if the session was created via Multi-Tenant Orchestrator (MTO) Single Sign-On.

isGlpSsoSession.description: Indicates if the session was created via Global License Platform (GLP) Single Sign-On.

UserSessionInfo.description: Session management configuration wrapper containing timeout settings and metadata.

resourceBase.description: Resource identifier path for session management configuration.

resourceKey.description: Optional sub-resource identifier. Typically null for session settings.

configData.description: Session timeout settings containing autoLogout and maxSession values.

version.description: Configuration version number for optimistic locking.

timestamp.description: Last modification timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

sessionDetail.description: Session timeout configuration for idle timeout and concurrent session limits. Used when updating session management settings.

autoLogout.description: Idle timeout in minutes before automatic logout. Range: 1-10080 (1 minute to 7 days).
autoLogout.x-validation: Validated server-side; values outside 1-10080 return 400 Bad Request

maxSession.description: Maximum concurrent user sessions across all users. Range: 5-10000.
maxSession.x-validation: Validated server-side; values outside 5-10000 return 400 Bad Request

ShaperResponse.description: WAN shaper configuration containing traffic class definitions and bandwidth settings

ShaperTimeSeriesStatsData.description: Individual shaper statistics record with named fields. This schema documents the meaning of each field in the data arrays.

TIMESTAMP.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds representing the start of the aggregation interval.

TrafficClass.description: QoS traffic class identifier (1-10). Class 1 has highest priority, class 10 has lowest priority.

direction.description: Traffic direction: 0 = outbound (WAN-bound traffic), 1 = inbound (LAN-bound traffic).

totalBytes.description: Total bytes processed through the shaper for this traffic class and direction.

shapedBytes.description: Bytes that were shaped (queued/delayed) by the QoS policy.

shapedPkts.description: Number of packets that were shaped (queued/delayed) by the QoS policy.

totalWait.description: Cumulative queue wait time in milliseconds for all packets.

waitCount.description: Number of packets that experienced queuing delay (waited in queue).

qosDrops.description: Packets dropped due to QoS policy enforcement (queue overflow, rate limiting).

otherDrops.description: Packets dropped for reasons other than QoS (errors, congestion).

TrafficClass.description: Individual traffic class configuration defining QoS parameters

name.description: Human-readable name identifying the traffic class (e.g., 'Default', 'Voice', 'Video')

max_bw.description: Maximum bandwidth percentage allocated to this traffic class (0-100)

accuracy.description: Shaper accuracy level for this traffic class

WanShaperConfig.description: WAN interface shaper configuration with traffic classes and global settings

traffic-class.description: Map of traffic class IDs to their configurations

accuracy.description: Shaper accuracy level for bandwidth enforcement

max_bw.description: Maximum bandwidth limit in Kbps for the WAN interface

ShellAccessSettingData.description: Response object containing the current shell access setting

shellAccessSetting.description: Current shell access security level on the Orchestrator. Controls SSH access permissions.

ShellAccessSettingEnum.description: Shell access security levels in order of increasing restriction. Once increased, security level cannot be decreased.

x-enum-descriptions.open: Full shell access enabled - allows unrestricted SSH access (least secure, security level 0)
x-enum-descriptions.lockdown_ssa: Secure Shell Access mode - restricted shell with limited commands available (security level 1)
x-enum-descriptions.lockdown: Shell access completely disabled - no SSH access allowed (most secure, security level 2)

ShellAccessSettingError.description: Error response returned when shell access setting update fails

error.description: Error message describing why the update failed
error.example: Update is not permitted, check shell access setting and allowed order.

ShellAccessSettingPostBody.description: Request body for updating the shell access setting. The shellAccessSetting field is required and must contain a valid security level.

shellAccessSetting.description: Target shell access security level. Must be equal to or more restrictive than the current setting. Security levels: 'open' (0) < 'lockdown_ssa' (1) < 'lockdown' (2).

x-constraints.description: Value must have security level >= current setting

SnmpAccess.description: SNMP access control settings for SNMPv1/v2c.

rocommunity.description: Read-only community string for SNMPv1/v2c access. Acts as a password for read operations.

SnmpAdmin.description: SNMPv3 admin user authentication and privacy settings.

self.description: Username identifier. Always 'admin' as only admin user is supported for SNMPv3.

enable.description: When true, the admin user is enabled for SNMPv3 authentication.

hash_type.description: Authentication hash algorithm for SNMPv3 authentication password.

auth_key.description: Hashed authentication password for SNMPv3. Value is encrypted and not returned in plain text.

privacy_type.description: Encryption algorithm for SNMPv3 privacy (data encryption).

privacy_key.description: Hashed privacy password for SNMPv3 encryption. Value is encrypted and not returned in plain text.

SnmpItem.description: Complete SNMP configuration for an appliance including agent settings, access controls, trap configuration, and SNMPv3 user information.

syscontact.description: SNMP MIB-II sysContact value. Identifies the contact person for this managed node, including email or phone information.

sysdescr.description: SNMP MIB-II sysDescr value. Full description of the system including hardware and software details.

syslocation.description: SNMP MIB-II sysLocation value. Physical location of the appliance (e.g., data center name, rack position).

auto_launch.description: Indicates whether the SNMP agent starts automatically on system boot. When true, SNMP service is enabled at startup.

listen.description: SNMP agent listening state on standard port 161.

access.description: SNMP access configuration including community strings for SNMPv1/v2c.

v3.description: SNMPv3 user authentication and encryption configuration.

enable.description: When true, SNMP agent listens on UDP port 161 for incoming SNMP requests.
When true, SNMP trap notifications are enabled. The appliance will send traps to configured trap receivers.

trap_community.description: Community string included in SNMP trap notifications. Trap receivers must be configured with this string to receive traps.

SnmpUser.description: SNMPv3 user definitions. Currently only supports the admin user.

admin.description: Admin user SNMPv3 configuration. Only the admin user is available as an SNMPv3 user.

AppGroupPortalEntry.description: Defines an application group with its associated applications.

group.description: Name of the application group (category).

apps.description: List of application names belonging to this group.

type.description: Type identifier for the application group. 0 indicates portal-defined group.

ApplicationTagsInfoResponse.description: Response containing the application tags version hash.

hashVal.description: Hash code representing the current version of application tags data. Used to detect changes and synchronize application group definitions. A value of '0' indicates no data is currently available.

BroadcastMessage.description: A single broadcast message from the HPE Aruba Portal.

_id.description: Unique identifier for the broadcast message from the portal.

message.description: The broadcast message content displayed to users.
message.example: Scheduled maintenance on December 15, 2024 from 2:00 AM to 4:00 AM UTC.

createdOn.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the message was created.

modifiedOn.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the message was last modified.

expireAfter.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the message expires and should no longer be displayed.

CaseCreationErrorResponse.description: Error message string returned when case creation fails

CaseCreationSuccessResponse.description: Response returned when case is successfully created

CheckApplianceReachability.description: Reachability status for a single WebSocket connection path.

reachable.description: True if appliance responded to WebSocket ping, false otherwise.

err.description: Error message if connection failed, null on success.

CompoundClassificationEntry.description: Defines a compound application classification rule with multiple matching criteria for traffic identification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the classification entry.

name.description: Display name of the application classification rule.

description.description: Human-readable description of the classification rule and its purpose.

confidence.description: Classification confidence level (0-100). Higher values indicate stronger match confidence when multiple rules could apply.

disabled.description: Whether this classification rule is disabled. When true, the rule is not used for traffic matching.

protocol.description: IP protocol to match (e.g., 'tcp', 'udp', 'icmp', or protocol number). Empty string matches any protocol.

dscp.description: DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) value to match for QoS-based classification. Empty string matches any DSCP.

src_ip.description: Source IP address or CIDR range to match (IPv4). Empty string matches any source IP.

src_port.description: Source port number or port range (e.g., '80' or '1024-65535'). Empty string matches any source port.

src_dns.description: Source DNS pattern to match (supports wildcards). Empty string matches any source DNS.

src_geo.description: Source geographic location code (ISO country code). Empty string matches any source location.

src_service.description: Source SaaS application name or organization to match. Empty string matches any source service.

dst_ip.description: Destination IP address or CIDR range to match (IPv4). Empty string matches any destination IP.

dst_port.description: Destination port number or port range (e.g., '443' or '80,443'). Empty string matches any destination port.

dst_dns.description: Destination DNS pattern to match (supports wildcards like '*.example.com'). Empty string matches any destination DNS.

dst_geo.description: Destination geographic location code (ISO country code). Empty string matches any destination location.

dst_service.description: Destination SaaS application name or organization to match. Empty string matches any destination service.

either_ip.description: IP address or CIDR range that can match either source or destination. Empty string disables this criterion.

either_port.description: Port number or range that can match either source or destination. Empty string disables this criterion.

either_dns.description: DNS pattern that can match either source or destination. Empty string disables this criterion.

either_geo.description: Geographic location code that can match either source or destination. Empty string disables this criterion.

either_service.description: SaaS application or organization that can match either source or destination. Empty string disables this criterion.

vlan.description: VLAN interface identifier to match. Empty string matches any VLAN.

hashVal.description: Hash code representing the version of compound classification data. Used to detect changes in application definition data from the portal. A value of '0' indicates no data is currently available.

CompoundClassificationInfoResponse.description: Response object containing the compound classification version hash. This hash serves as a version identifier to determine if compound classification data has been updated on the Cloud Portal.

CountryServiceDetails.description: Array of 8 string elements representing service details for a country.
example: SaaS App, Example Org, United States

DnsObj.description: DNS classification entry that maps a domain pattern to an application name

domain.description: Domain name pattern for matching. Supports wildcards (e.g., *.example.com).

name.description: Application name to associate with matching domains.

priority.description: Priority value for classification rule ordering. Higher values indicate higher priority.

GeoLocateIpRequestBody.description: Array of IP addresses for batch geolocation lookup. Each IP must be a 32-bit unsigned integer (0-4294967295). IPs are processed in batches of 10 internally.

items.description: IPv4 address as 32-bit unsigned integer. Convert from dotted notation using: (octet1 * 16777216) + (octet2 * 65536) + (octet3 * 256) + octet4

GeoLocationObject.description: Geographic location data for a single IP address including city, country, coordinates, and network range information.

city.description: City name where the IP is located.

country.description: Full country name where the IP is located.

ip.description: The queried IP address in 32-bit unsigned integer format.

isp.description: Internet Service Provider name for the IP address.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

org.description: Organization name associated with the IP address.

postalCode.description: Postal or ZIP code for the IP location (may be null for some regions).

rangeIpEnd.description: End IP of the subnet containing the geolocated IP (32-bit unsigned integer).

rangeIpStart.description: Start IP of the subnet containing the geolocated IP (32-bit unsigned integer).

GeoLocationResponse.description: Map of geolocation results where each key is the IP address (as string) and value is the corresponding GeoLocationObject.

IpIntelTmpObj.description: Represents an IP intelligence classification record containing IP range and associated metadata.

ip_start.description: Starting IPv4 address as a 32-bit unsigned integer. Range: 0 to 4294967295.

ip_end.description: Ending IPv4 address as a 32-bit unsigned integer. Range: 0 to 4294967295.

service_id.description: Unique identifier for the service classification.

saas_id.description: Identifier linking to the SaaS application definition.

country.description: Full country name associated with the IP range.

org.description: Organization or company name owning the IP range.

name.description: Display name of the SaaS application.

description.description: Human-readable description of the IP range or service.

priority.description: Classification priority for conflict resolution. Higher values indicate higher priority.

search.description: Concatenated searchable text field containing keywords for filtering.

subattributes.description: JSON string containing additional classification attributes.

LicenseTypeObject.description: License type details containing internal name and display name

name.description: Internal license type identifier. Common values: 'cpn' (AAS), 'fx' (EC), 'none' (not registered)

displayName.description: Human-readable license type name. Common values: 'AAS', 'EC', 'None'

MeterFlowClassificationInfo.description: Contains the hash value representing the version of meter flow classification data.

hashVal.description: Hash code representing the current version of meter flow classification data. Returns '0' when no data is available.

MeterFlowClassificationResponse.description: Array of meter flow classification entries containing flow type definitions

MeterFlowObj.description: Individual meter flow definition representing a classifiable application or protocol

mid.description: Unique meter flow identifier used for internal reference and matching

name.description: Human-readable name of the application or protocol (e.g., HTTP, HTTPS, FTP)

priority.description: Classification priority where higher values indicate higher precedence in flow matching

PortApplication.description: Application information associated with a TCP or UDP port.

name.description: Internal application identifier used for classification.

displayName.description: Human-readable application name for UI display.

PortProtocolClassificationInfo.description: Contains the hash value representing the current version of port protocol classification data.

hashVal.description: Hash code representing the version of port protocol classification data. Value '0' indicates no data available. Non-zero values represent valid data versions for cache comparison.

PortProtocolEntry.description: Individual port/protocol classification entry defining an application mapping

name.description: Application or protocol name identifier

description.description: Human-readable description of the application or protocol

port.description: Port number or port range as string (e.g., '80', '8080-8090')

protocol.description: IP protocol number (6=TCP, 17=UDP, 0=any). Based on IANA protocol numbers.

priority.description: Classification priority for conflict resolution. Higher values indicate higher priority.

PortProtocolMap.description: Map of port numbers to their protocol classification entries. Keys are port numbers as strings.

additionalProperties.description: List of protocol entries for this port number

PortProtocolTmp.description: Container for port protocol classification data including application tags and port/protocol mappings with priority

applicationTags.description: Mapping of application category tags to their associated application names

additionalProperties.description: List of application names belonging to this category

PortalRegistrationResponse.description: Orchestrator-Portal registration status including primary and secondary account states.

registered.description: Indicates if Orchestrator has registered with Cloud Portal.

enabled.description: Indicates if registration has been approved by Administrator (manually or auto-approved).

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code from the last Portal registration request. 0 indicates no request has been made.

secondaryAccounts.description: Map of secondary account names to their registration status.

PortalSecondaryAccountRegistrationRespon.description: Response containing the registration status of all secondary accounts with Portal.

pendingPoll.description: True when Orchestrator is actively polling Portal for updated registration status. Poll again when true.

msg.description: Global error message from Portal if registration encountered issues. Empty string when successful.

secondaryAccounts.description: List of all configured secondary accounts with their individual registration status and details.

PrimaryAccountKeyChangeStatusResp.description: Response object containing key change status for the primary account and all secondary accounts.

generateTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds when the new account key was generated. Null if account key has never been rotated.

committedToPortalTimestamp.description: Epoch time in milliseconds when the old account key was deleted from Cloud Portal. Null if the key rotation is still in progress (new key generated but old key not yet deleted).

secondaryAccounts.description: Map of secondary account names to their respective key change status objects.

RegistrationStatusResponse.description: Extended registration status returned by POST endpoint including account configuration details.

accountName.description: Portal account name configured for this Orchestrator.

accountKey.description: Portal account key used for authentication with Cloud Portal.

registered.description: Indicates if Orchestrator has registered with Cloud Portal.

enabled.description: Indicates if registration has been approved by Administrator.

httpStatusCode.description: HTTP status code from last Portal registration request. 0 means no request made yet.

pendingPoll.description: Indicates if registration is pending and background polling is active.

group.description: Portal group assignment for this Orchestrator.

site.description: Portal site assignment for this Orchestrator.

emails.description: List of notification email addresses from Portal configuration.

SaasClassificationHashResponse.description: Response containing the SaaS classification data version hash.

hashVal.description: Hash value representing the current version of SaaS classification data. Returns '0' if no data is cached.

SecondaryAccount.description: Configuration for a secondary Cloud Portal account used for multi-account registration.

accountId.description: Unique identifier for the account in the Cloud Portal. Obtained from the portal during account creation.

key.description: Current account key used for authentication with the Cloud Portal. Required for successful registration.

oldKey.description: Previous account key retained during key rotation. Used for graceful key transitions. Empty when not rotating keys.

group.description: Group name for organizing appliances within this account. Optional field for categorization.

password.description: Password for authentication. Optional - if omitted, uses existing stored password from backup configuration.

maxBackups.description: Maximum number of backup files to retain. Used for validation purposes.

description.description: Optional description for the backup configuration.

schedule.description: Optional schedule configuration. Not used during connection test but accepted for compatibility.

ScUseGmsConfigObject.description: Object containing the flag that determines whether stats collector backup uses Orchestrator backup configuration. When enabled, stats collectors inherit backup settings from the Orchestrator. Default value is true.

useGmsBackupConfig.description: Indicates whether stats collector backup uses Orchestrator backup configuration. True means stats collectors inherit Orchestrator's backup settings; false means custom backup configuration is used.

SetUseGmsConfigRequest.description: Request body for setting whether stats collector backup uses Orchestrator backup configuration. When useGmsBackupConfig is true without config, requires existing GMS backup configuration and schedule.

useGmsBackupConfig.description: If true, stats collectors inherit backup settings from Orchestrator's backup configuration. If false, custom backup configuration can be provided in the config property.

config.description: Custom backup configuration with schedule. Required when useGmsBackupConfig is false and you want to configure custom backup settings. Includes protocol, hostname, port, directory, username, password, maxBackups, description, and schedule.

TestConnectionResultObject.description: Result of a backup server connection test. Contains a success message with connection details.

message.description: Human-readable message describing the connection test result. On success, includes protocol type, host, port, directory, and username.

example.message: FTP Connection to Host: backup.example.com, Port No: 21, Directory: /backups/statscollector  with username: backupuser was successful.

UnsupportedAppliance.description: Details of an appliance that does not meet the minimum software version requirements for new stats collection. Appliances in this list require software upgrades.

applianceId.description: Hostname identifier of the appliance. Corresponds to the appliance's configured hostname in Orchestrator.

softwareVersion.description: Current software version of the appliance. May be null if version is unknown or appliance is unreachable.

scId.description: ID of the stats collector assigned to this appliance. May be null if no stats collector is assigned.

UnsupportedApplianceArray.description: Array of appliances that are incompatible with the new stats collection system. Empty array indicates all appliances are compatible.

associationsByNepksRequest.description: Request body for querying stats collector associations by appliance IDs.

scheduleObject.description: Schedule configuration for backup jobs. Defines when and how often backups run.

effectiveTime.description: Unix timestamp when the schedule becomes active.

endTime.description: Optional Unix timestamp when the schedule ends.

runNow.description: If true, runs the backup immediately in addition to the schedule.

statsCollectorAssociationsByNepks.description: Mapping of appliance IDs (nePks) to their assigned stats collector IDs. Each key is an appliance ID and the value is the stats collector ID assigned to that appliance.

additionalProperties.description: Stats collector ID assigned to the appliance.

NonStatsRetentionUpdateRequest.description: Request body for updating non-statistics table retention settings.

retention.description: Data retention period in seconds. Must be greater than 0 and greater than or equal to partitionDuration. Common values: 7776000 (90 days), 2592000 (30 days).

partitionDuration.description: Database partition duration in seconds. Must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to retention. The ratio retention/partitionDuration must not exceed 8192.

NonStatsTableRetentionEntry.description: Retention settings for a single non-statistics table.

retention.description: Data retention period in seconds. Uses custom retention if set, otherwise falls back to default. Common values: 7776000 (90 days), 2592000 (30 days).

partitionDuration.description: Database partition duration in seconds. Controls how data is partitioned for efficient storage and cleanup.

NonStatsTableRetentionResponse.description: Map of non-statistics table names to their retention settings. Each key is a table name (e.g., actionlog), and the value contains retention and partition duration.

actionlog.description: Retention settings for the actionlog (audit log) table.

StatsCollectionResponse.description: Map of statistics type names to their collection enabled status. Each key is a stat type name, and the value indicates whether collection is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

additionalProperties.description: Collection enabled status for the stat type. True means collection is active.

dscp.description: DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) statistics collection status.

boost.description: WAN Optimization (boost) statistics collection status.

port.description: Port statistics collection status.

ddospeakandpeakdroprate.description: DDoS peak and peak drop rate statistics collection status.

StatsRetentionEntry.description: Retention configuration for a specific granularity level.

granularity.description: Data aggregation granularity level. Determines the time period for data aggregation.

retention.description: Data retention period in seconds. Must be greater than 0. Common values: 259200 (3 days), 1209600 (14 days), 8035200 (93 days).

statType.description: Optional stat type identifier (usually passed in query parameter instead).

partitionDuration.description: Optional database partition duration in seconds.

StatsRetentionGranularityEntry.description: Retention configuration for a specific granularity level in the GET response.

retention.description: Data retention period in seconds. Common values: 259200 (3 days), 1209600 (14 days), 8035200 (93 days), 31536000 (365 days).

granularity.description: Data aggregation granularity level (uppercase). Determines the time period for data aggregation.

StatsRetentionNotificationInfo.description: Configuration object for stats retention notification dismissal status. Used to track which user has dismissed the notification and prevent repeated display.

isDismissed.description: Indicates whether the stats retention notification has been dismissed. When true, the notification will not be shown to users.

userName.description: The username of the Orchestrator user who last modified the notification status.

StatsRetentionResponse.description: Map of statistics type names to their retention settings at different granularity levels. Each stat type contains an array of retention configurations with granularity and retention period.

additionalProperties.description: Array of retention settings for different granularity levels (minute, hour, day, month).

tunnel.description: Tunnel statistics retention settings per granularity.

interface.description: Interface statistics retention settings per granularity.

flow.description: Flow statistics retention settings per granularity.

dscp.description: DSCP statistics retention settings per granularity.

boost.description: WAN Optimization (boost) statistics retention settings per granularity.

drops.description: Drops statistics retention settings per granularity.

shaper.description: Shaper statistics retention settings per granularity.

trafficclass.description: Traffic class statistics retention settings per granularity.

flowapp.description: Application flow statistics retention settings (hourly only).

flowuser.description: User flow statistics retention settings (hourly only).

port.description: Port statistics retention settings (hourly only).

toptalkers.description: Top talkers statistics retention settings (hourly only).

interfacebyoverlay.description: Interface-by-overlay statistics retention settings per granularity.

tunnelavailability.description: Tunnel availability statistics retention settings (minute, day, month).

tunnelhealth.description: Tunnel health statistics retention settings per granularity.

securitypolicy.description: Security policy statistics retention settings per granularity.

ddospeakandpeakdroprate.description: DDoS peak and peak drop rate statistics retention settings per granularity.

ddostotalstats.description: DDoS total statistics retention settings per granularity.

addosbaseline.description: DDoS baseline statistics retention settings (hourly only).

ipreputation.description: IP reputation statistics retention settings (minute only).

StatsRetentionUpdateRequest.description: Array of retention configurations for updating statistics retention at different granularity levels.

approximateDiskSpaceResponse.description: Map of statistics types to their estimated disk space usage in bytes per minute. Values are calculated based on appliance count, tunnel count, and segment count.

additionalProperties.description: Estimated disk space in bytes per minute for this statistics type

addosbaseline.description: DDoS baseline statistics disk space (bytes/min). Multiplied by numberOfSegments if provided.

boost.description: WAN Optimization (boost) statistics disk space (bytes/min).

dscp.description: Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) statistics disk space (bytes/min).

tunnel.description: Tunnel statistics disk space (bytes/min). Calculation uses numberOfTunnels if provided, otherwise derived from appliance count.

port.description: Port statistics disk space (bytes/min).

ddospeakandpeakdroprate.description: DDoS peak and peak drop rate statistics disk space (bytes/min). Multiplied by numberOfSegments if provided.

ddostotalstats.description: DDoS total statistics disk space (bytes/min). Multiplied by numberOfSegments if provided.

AllVRFsSubnetsResponse.description: Response containing subnet information for all VRF segments. Structure varies based on appliance version and VRF configuration.

subnets.description: Map of VRF segment IDs to subnet data. Keys are segment IDs (e.g., '0', '1') for VRF-enabled appliances, or 'NotSupported' for non-VRF or VRF-disabled configurations.

peers.description: Array of peer appliances sharing subnet information.

ConfigurePostData.description: Request body for configuring subnets on a legacy appliance. Contains IPv4 subnet definitions with routing and advertising settings.

ipv4.description: Map of IPv4 subnets keyed by CIDR notation (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24'). Each entry defines subnet routing and advertising configuration.

peers.description: Each element of this array is an object describing one peer's detail information, and the minimum number of the elements is 0

Ipv4.description: Map of IPv4 subnets with their configuration. Keys are subnet CIDR notations (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

time since change.description: The seconds that have passed since last change.

One_subnet.description: Configuration for a single subnet including advertising, locality, and routing settings.

advert.description: When true, advertises this subnet to SD-WAN fabric peers. Controls route propagation across the overlay network.

advert_bgp.description: When true, advertises this subnet to BGP neighbors. Only applicable for appliances with BGP configured.

comment.description: Optional user-defined comment or description for this subnet entry. Max 255 characters.

local.description: When true, marks this subnet as locally connected to this appliance. Local subnets are directly reachable.

metric.description: Route metric value for this subnet. Lower values indicate higher priority. Range: 0-65535.

entries.description: Each element of this array is one object describing a subnet's detail information, and the minimum number of the elements is 0

max.description: The max number of the subnets this appliance can have.

SubnetsSystemJson.description: Request body for configuring subnet sharing options on an appliance.

auto_subnet.description: Subnet sharing and auto-advertising configuration settings.

CacheSyncState.description: Represents the synchronization state between cache and database for a specific configuration resource.

resourcePath.description: The full resource path identifying the configuration item.

databaseData.description: Current configuration data stored in the database. Null if no data exists in database.

cachedData.description: Current configuration data stored in the in-memory cache. Null if no data exists in cache.

syncRequired.description: True if cache and database data differ and synchronization is needed. False when both are null or contain identical data.

CacheUpdateResult.description: Status message for a single resource path cache update. Format: '{path}: {status}'. Status values: 'Update successful', 'No configuration found in the database for this resource', or 'update failed - {error message}'.
CacheUpdateResult.pattern: ^.+: (Update successful|No configuration found in the database for this resource|update failed - .+)$

CacheUpdateResultArray.description: Array of status messages indicating the result of each cache update operation.
example: /zscaler/configuration: No configuration found in the database for this resource

ResourcePath.description: Valid resource paths for cache synchronization. Paths correspond to GMS configuration resources stored in the database.

ResourcePathArray.description: Array of resource paths to synchronize from database to cache.

ChangedObject.description: Threshold crossing configuration specifying raise/clear values and sustain period.

clearVal.description: Value at which the alert clears after being raised. Must be less than raiseVal for rising thresholds.

is_set.description: Whether this threshold configuration has been explicitly set (vs using defaults).

raiseVal.description: Value at which the alert is triggered. For rising thresholds, alert triggers when metric exceeds this value.

sustain.description: Number of consecutive intervals the threshold must be crossed before triggering an alert. 0 means immediate triggering.

DftData.description: Default threshold settings containing enable state and rising/falling threshold configurations.

enable.description: Whether threshold crossing alerts are enabled for this metric.

falling.description: Falling threshold configuration (alert when value drops below threshold).

rising.description: Rising threshold configuration (alert when value exceeds threshold).

InstBNameData.description: Map of instance identifiers (1-1000) to tunnel/interface configuration references. Keys are numeric strings representing tunnel or interface instances.

InstBNameObject.description: Instance base name object containing tunnel or interface configuration reference.

name.description: Configuration path reference for the instance.

self.description: Instance identifier matching the parent key (1-1000).

TcaDataInfo.description: Threshold configuration for a specific TCA metric including UI settings, default values, and configurable limits.

UI.description: UI display and configuration settings for this metric.

allow_disable.description: Whether this TCA metric can be disabled.

allow_falling.description: Whether falling threshold alerts are supported for this metric.

allow_rising.description: Whether rising threshold alerts are supported for this metric.

threshold_max.description: Maximum configurable threshold value for this metric.

threshold_min.description: Minimum configurable threshold value for this metric.

TcaInfo.description: Complete TCA configuration containing all monitored system metrics. Each property represents a specific metric with its threshold settings.

latency.description: Network latency monitoring thresholds (tunnel-specific, includes inst_bname).

loss-post-fec.description: Packet loss after Forward Error Correction thresholds (tunnel-specific).

loss-pre-fec.description: Packet loss before Forward Error Correction thresholds (tunnel-specific).

TcaUIInfo.description: UI configuration and display settings for a TCA metric.

allow_config.description: Whether users can configure thresholds for this metric in the UI.

descr.description: Human-readable description displayed in the UI (e.g., 'Tunnel OOP pre-POC').

inst_bname.description: Instance base names for tunnel-specific metrics. Present for: latency, loss-post-fec, loss-pre-fec, oop-pre-poc, oop-post-poc, reduction, utilization. Absent for: file-system-utilization, lan-side-rx-throughput, optimized-flows, wan-side-tx-throughput, total-flows.

InterfaceProperty.description: Properties identifying a specific interface or tunnel for packet capture.

type.description: Interface type (e.g., 'tunnel', 'wan', 'lan').

name.description: Display name or alias for the interface.

source.description: Source IP address of the tunnel endpoint.

destination.description: Destination IP address of the tunnel endpoint.

mode.description: Tunnel mode or protocol (e.g., 'udp', 'tcp').

PostRunConfig.description: Configuration for initiating a packet capture operation.

max_packet.description: Maximum number of packets to capture. Ignored when circularStorage is enabled.

ip.description: Filter to capture only packets involving this IP address (source or destination).

port.description: Filter to capture only packets on this port number (source or destination).

additionalOptions.description: Additional tcpdump filter expression (BPF syntax) for advanced filtering.

interfaces.description: List of specific interfaces/tunnels to capture on. If empty, captures on all interfaces.

circularStorage.description: Enable circular storage mode for continuous capture. When enabled, capture rotates through a fixed number of files.

maxSizePerFile.description: Maximum size per capture file in MB when circular storage is enabled.

numberOfFiles.description: Maximum number of capture files to maintain when circular storage is enabled.

snapLength.description: Snapshot length - number of bytes to capture per packet. Lower values reduce file size but may truncate packet data.

TcpdumpStatus.description: Real-time status of a packet capture operation retrieved from an appliance.

active.description: True when tcpdump is currently running. Check this to determine if a capture is in progress.

lastOneDone.description: True when the previous capture completed. Useful to verify completion after active becomes false.

progress.description: Capture progress from 0.0 to 1.0. Null when capture is starting and progress is unavailable.

status.description: Additional status metadata from the appliance. Contains capture-specific details when available.

x-field-behavior.progress: Null until capture begins, then updates from 0.0 to 1.0
x-field-behavior.active: True when capture starts, false when it stops
x-field-behavior.lastOneDone: True when the most recent capture finishes

AllApplianceAssociationsMap.description: Map of all appliance IDs to their associated template group names. Returned when querying associations without specifying a specific appliance (nePk).

additionalProperties.description: Array of template group names associated with the appliance

ApplianceAssociation2Obj.description: Map of appliance IDs to template group names associated with them

templateIds.description: Array of template group names to associate with the appliance

ApplianceAssociation2Post.description: An array of objects, each containing an appliance ID and the corresponding template groups.

valObject.description: Template configuration data as a JSON object. Structure varies by template type. Use GET /template/templateGroups?templateGroup=Default+Template+Group to retrieve the current `value` field for each template as a reference. The `value` field on GET responses shows the current configuration; send updated configuration via `valObject` on POST. Note: sensitive fields like passwords are redacted (empty string) on GET but must be supplied on POST.

templates.description: An array of the templates you want to create/update

TemplateCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a new template group. The group is initialized with templates from the Default Template Group, with provided template values overriding defaults.

name.description: Unique name for the template group. Must not be empty or whitespace only. Names are trimmed before validation.

comment.description: Optional comment for audit logging purposes. Recorded in the system action log.

templates.description: Optional array of template configurations to override defaults. If omitted, all templates use Default Template Group values.

TemplateDeleteBody.description: Request body for deleting a template group. Contains the group name to delete and an optional audit comment.

templateGroup.description: Name of the template group to delete. Must not be empty, null, or 'Default Template Group'.

comment.description: Optional comment for audit logging. Recorded in the system action log with 'Audit Log Comment : ' prefix.

TemplateGroupFull.description: Complete template group object containing group metadata and all templates. Template groups are collections of device configuration templates (e.g., 'users', 'system', 'qosMaps') identified by **name** (string), not numeric ID. Each group contains ~47 individual templates with an `isSelected` flag controlling whether each is active. Encrypted data is removed before returning.

name.description: Unique name of the template group. Used as the identifier in all API calls.

comment.description: Optional comment or description for the template group.

templates.description: Array of all template configurations within this group, both selected and unselected.

selectedTemplates.description: Subset of templates where isSelected is true. Only these templates are applied to associated appliances during orchestration.

selectedTemplateNames.description: Flat list of internal template names that are currently selected (enabled) in this group.

TemplateGroupPostRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating a template group. When 'name' matches the 'templateGroup' query parameter, the group is updated. When they differ, a new template group is created from the source.

name.description: Source template group name (for cloning) or target group name (for updating). Must match an existing template group.

comment.description: Optional audit log comment. Recorded in the system action log with 'Audit Log Comment : ' prefix.
comment.example: Updated QoS settings for branch offices

templates.description: Array of templates to save. Each template contains configuration data that will be applied to the group.

TemplateGroupPriorities.description: Object containing the ordered priority list of template groups. The order determines which template settings take precedence when multiple groups are associated with an appliance.

priorities.description: Ordered list of template group names. Groups listed earlier have higher priority and their template settings take precedence over groups listed later.

items.description: Template group name

TemplateHistoryItem.description: Represents a single template application history record for an appliance.

templateGroup.description: Name of the template group containing the applied template.

templateName.description: Name of the specific template that was applied. Empty string indicates a template group-level record.

appliedOn.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the template was applied.

user.description: Username of the user who applied the template.

status.description: Status of the template application. Only 'successful' records are returned.

statusMessage.description: Detailed message describing the result of the template application.

TemplateItem.description: Individual template configuration with metadata and value. Returned on GET responses. The `value` field contains the current configuration as a JSON object (sensitive fields like passwords are redacted). The `valObject` field is null on GET; use it on POST to send updated configuration.

name.description: Internal template name identifier. See TemplateConfigItem for the full list of valid names and their display names.

value.description: Current template configuration data as a JSON object. Structure varies by template type. Sensitive fields (passwords, keys) are redacted as empty strings. For the 'users' template, this is `{"users": {"<username>": {"self": "<username>", "enable": true, "gid": 0, "password": "REDACTED_EXAMPLE", "gms_marked": true}}}`. For policy templates (qosMaps, securityMaps, etc.), this typically contains `data` and `options` objects.

valObject.description: Always null on GET responses. On POST, supply the updated template configuration here instead of in `value`.

buildVersion.description: Minimum appliance software version required for this template.

lastSaved.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the template was last saved.

path.description: Internal REST path used when applying the template to an appliance. Not used in API calls.

isselected.description: Whether this template is selected (enabled) for application. Lowercase variant; see also `isSelected`.

isSelected.description: Whether this template is selected (enabled) for application. CamelCase variant of `isselected`; both are returned.

userId.description: Username or email of the last user to modify this template.

auditLogComment.description: Comment recorded in the audit log for the last modification.

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the template (read-only). Maps internal names to labels (e.g., 'users' → 'User Management', 'qosMaps' → 'QoS Policies').

name.description: The name of the template. See the default template group for all the names of the templates

TemplatePostItem.description: Template configuration item for POST requests. Contains the template name and configuration object.

name.description: Template name identifier. Must match a valid template name from the Default Template Group (e.g., 'qosMaps', 'securityMaps', 'aclMaps').

valObject.description: Template configuration data as a JSON object. Structure varies by template type. Capture the correct format from the Orchestrator UI or GET /template/templateGroups response.

applianceAssociationGetNepk.description: Map of appliance IDs to template group names associated with them

templateIds.description: Names of the template groups associated with this appliance

ThirdPartyLicenses.description: Plain text content containing all third-party software licenses. Each license entry includes library name, version, and full license text. Lines are separated by CRLF (\r\n).
