ApplianceAssociation.description: Individual appliance association with Zscaler service. Used to configure which appliances participate in Zscaler cloud security integration.

priority.description: Orchestration priority level. High priority (1) appliances are polled first during Zscaler orchestration cycles. After processing, priority resets to 0.

x-enum-descriptions.1: High priority - processed first in orchestration queue, then reset to 0

lastUpdateTime.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds (epoch) of the last association update. Automatically updated when priority changes or association is modified.

ApplianceEntity.description: Represents an EdgeConnect appliance within a site mapping context.

applianceName.description: Hostname of the appliance as configured in Orchestrator.

recommendSite.description: The site ID that was recommended by auto-mapping based on geographic proximity. May differ from current site if manually reassigned. Value is '0' if no site was recommended.

gmsMarked.description: Indicates whether this appliance was manually assigned to the site (true) or auto-mapped based on geographic coordinates (false).

AwsApplianceArtifactAssociationRule.description: Defines an association rule between EdgeConnect appliances and AWS VPC routing artifacts. Used for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager integration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the association rule. Use 0 for new rules; auto-assigned on creation.

ruleName.description: User-defined name for the association rule. Should be descriptive and unique.

awsRegion.description: AWS region identifier where the VPC is located (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1).

awsVpcId.description: AWS VPC identifier to associate with appliances. Format: vpc-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.

awsRtbId.description: AWS Route Table identifier within the VPC. Format: rtb-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.

awsVpcName.description: Human-readable name of the AWS VPC. Optional, used for display purposes.

awsRtbName.description: Human-readable name of the AWS Route Table. Optional, used for display purposes.

AwsArtifactApplianceConfig.description: Configuration specifying which EdgeConnect appliances are included in the association rule. Use filters (region, group, nePk) or set 'all' to true.

region.description: List of Orchestrator region IDs to filter appliances. Empty array means no region filter applied.

group.description: List of appliance group names to include. Empty array means no group filter applied.

nePk.description: List of specific appliance network element primary keys (NE PKs). Takes precedence over region and group filters.

all.description: When true, includes all appliances regardless of other filter settings. Overrides region, group, and nePk filters.

AwsArtifactsResponse.description: Map of AWS region codes to arrays of VPC artifacts. Keys are AWS region identifiers (e.g., us-east-1, ap-south-2).

additionalProperties.description: List of VPC artifacts for the region

AwsRoute.description: AWS route entry in a route table defining traffic routing rules

destinationCidrBlock.description: Destination IPv4 CIDR block for the route

destinationIpv6CidrBlock.description: Destination IPv6 CIDR block for the route

destinationPrefixListId.description: AWS prefix list ID for the destination

egressOnlyInternetGatewayId.description: Egress-only internet gateway ID for IPv6 outbound traffic

gatewayId.description: Internet gateway, virtual private gateway, or 'local' for VPC local routes

instanceId.description: EC2 instance ID if route targets an instance

instanceOwnerId.description: AWS account ID that owns the target instance

natGatewayId.description: NAT gateway ID for private subnet internet access

transitGatewayId.description: Transit gateway ID for cross-VPC or on-premises routing

localGatewayId.description: Local gateway ID for Outposts routing

carrierGatewayId.description: Carrier gateway ID for Wavelength Zone routing

networkInterfaceId.description: Elastic network interface (ENI) ID for the route target

origin.description: How the route was created: CreateRouteTable, CreateRoute, or EnableVgwRoutePropagation

state.description: Route state: active or blackhole

vpcPeeringConnectionId.description: VPC peering connection ID for cross-VPC traffic

coreNetworkArn.description: AWS Cloud WAN core network ARN

AwsRouteTableArtifact.description: AWS route table artifact with associated subnets and routes

routeTableId.description: AWS route table identifier. Format: rtb-[17 alphanumeric characters]

routeTableName.description: Human-readable route table name from AWS tags

subnetsList.description: Map of subnet IDs to subnet artifacts associated with this route table

routes.description: List of routes configured in this route table

AwsSegmentFirewallAssociationEntity.description: Defines the mapping between an EdgeConnect segment and AWS segments with associated firewall zone and role configuration.

edgeConnectSegment.description: EdgeConnect segment ID (VRF identifier). Used as the primary key for upsert operations.

edgeConnectFirewallZone.description: Firewall zone ID for the EdgeConnect segment. Used for zone-based firewall policy application.

edgeConnectRole.description: Firewall role ID. Must exist in system roles and cannot be 1 (Unknown). Role 1 causes validation failure.

awsSegment.description: List of AWS segments associated with this EdgeConnect segment.

AwsSegmentResource.description: AWS segment resource containing segment ID, name, type (TGW or CNE), and region.

awsSegmentId.description: Unique identifier for the AWS segment (route table ID for TGW, segment ID for CNE).

awsSegmentName.description: Human-readable name of the AWS segment.

isCneSegment.description: True for Cloud Network Edge (CNE) segments, false for Transit Gateway route table segments.

awsRegion.description: AWS region identifier where the segment resides (e.g., us-west-2, eu-west-1).

AwsSubnetArtifact.description: AWS subnet artifact with network configuration details

routeTableAssociationId.description: Route table association identifier. Format: rtbassoc-[17 alphanumeric characters]

subnetId.description: AWS subnet identifier. Format: subnet-[17 alphanumeric characters]

subnetName.description: Human-readable subnet name from AWS tags

subnetIpV4CIDR.description: IPv4 CIDR block assigned to the subnet

vpcId.description: AWS VPC identifier this subnet belongs to

subnetArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the subnet

AwsTgnmCnEdgesObject.description: Complete AWS Core Network configuration including global network association, segments, edges, and metadata.

globalNetworkId.description: Unique identifier of the AWS Global Network containing this Core Network.

coreNetworkId.description: Unique identifier of the AWS Core Network (Cloud WAN).

coreNetworkArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the Core Network, used for IAM policies and cross-account access.

description.description: User-defined description of the Core Network purpose or configuration.

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the Core Network was created in AWS.

state.description: Current operational state of the Core Network.

segments.description: List of network segments configured within this Core Network.

edges.description: List of Core Network Edge (CNE) deployments across AWS regions.

tags.description: AWS resource tags assigned to the Core Network for organization and billing.

AwsTgnmConnectionArtifact.description: AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager connection artifact containing BGP peer status information.

interface_label.description: Interface label ID used for the AWS VPN connection.

segment.description: VRF segment name. Defaults to 'Default' for WAN connections.

tgw_id.description: AWS Transit Gateway ID to which the VPN connection is established.

tgw_name.description: Human-readable name of the AWS Transit Gateway.

bgpStatus.description: Map of BGP peer IP addresses to their current state (e.g., 'Established', 'Active', 'Idle').

connectionStatus.description: Overall connection status computed from BGP peer states.

AwsTgnmConnectivityResponse.description: Response object containing AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager connectivity status.

AwsTgnmEdgesObject.description: AWS Core Network Edge (CNE) configuration for a specific region, including BGP and CIDR settings.

edgeLocation.description: AWS region identifier where this edge is deployed (e.g., us-east-1).

asn.description: BGP Autonomous System Number assigned to this edge location. Used for BGP peering with appliances.

insideCidrBlocks.description: CIDR block allocated for internal tunnel IP addressing between CNE and connected attachments.

AwsTgnmInterfacesIdHolder.description: Request body for setting AWS TGNM interface label order. Contains arrays of primary and backup interface label IDs.

Interface label ID. Must reference a valid WAN interface label.

items.description: Array of interface label IDs as strings.
Interface label ID referencing a configured WAN interface label.

AwsTgnmPauseOrchestration.description: Represents the pause/resume state for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager orchestration. Controls whether automatic synchronization and configuration updates to AWS TGNM resources are active.

paused.description: Indicates whether AWS TGNM orchestration is paused. When true, automatic orchestration is suspended. When false, orchestration is active and syncs with AWS resources.

AwsTgnmSegmentsObject.description: AWS Cloud WAN segment configuration defining network isolation boundaries and routing policies.

name.description: Unique identifier name for the network segment. Used for routing and policy configuration.

edgeLocations.description: List of AWS regions where this segment is deployed. Corresponds to CNE edge locations.

sharedSegments.description: List of segment names that can communicate with this segment through shared routing.

awsAccessKeyId.description: AWS IAM access key ID used to authenticate with AWS services. Required for initial subscription setup.

awsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS IAM secret access key. Required for initial setup; stored encrypted. Omit when updating only the access key ID.

AwsTgnmSubscription.description: AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager subscription credentials for authenticating with AWS services.

AwsTgnmTransitGatewayObjectTags.description: AWS resource tag key-value pair for categorization and management.

key.description: Tag key identifier (e.g., Environment, Project, Owner).

value.description: Tag value associated with the key.

AwsTgnmVtiCidr.title: AWS TGNM VTI CIDR Configuration
AwsTgnmVtiCidr.description: Virtual Tunnel Interface (VTI) IP pool configuration for AWS Transit Gateway Network Manager integration.

ipAddress.description: Base IP address of the VTI subnet pool. Must be a valid IPv4 address in the link-local range (169.254.x.x recommended for AWS VPN tunnels).

mask.description: CIDR subnet mask length for the VTI pool. Defines the size of the IP address range available for VTI allocation.

AwsTgnmZoneObject.description: Array of AWS segment-to-EdgeConnect firewall zone associations for Transit Gateway Network Manager integration.

AwsTgwArtifacts.description: AWS Transit Gateway artifact containing identification and configuration details. Null fields are omitted from the response.

tgwId.description: Unique AWS Transit Gateway identifier (e.g., tgw-0abc123def456789).

tgwName.description: Human-readable name assigned to the Transit Gateway in AWS.

tgwArn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) uniquely identifying the Transit Gateway resource.

isGlobalNetworkAssociated.description: Indicates if TGW is associated with a Global Network. Always false for this endpoint since it returns only unassociated TGWs.

globalNetworkId.description: AWS Global Network identifier if associated. Typically null or omitted for TGWs returned by this endpoint.

globalNetworkName.description: Name of the associated AWS Global Network. Typically null or omitted for TGWs returned by this endpoint.

region.description: AWS region where the Transit Gateway is deployed (e.g., us-west-2, eu-west-1).

transitGatewayCidrBlocks.description: List of CIDR blocks associated with the Transit Gateway for IP address management.

items.description: CIDR block in standard notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).

AwsTgwAssociationMap.description: Map of Global Network IDs to their associated Transit Gateway artifacts.

AwsThirdPartyTunnelSetting.description: AWS-specific IPsec/IKE tunnel configuration extending base ThirdPartyTunnelSetting with EdgeConnect segment support

admin.description: Administrative status of the tunnel. Controls whether the tunnel is operationally enabled.

mode.description: Tunnel mode type. WAN interfaces use 'ipsec_ip', LAN interfaces use 'gre'.

autoMaxBandwidthEnabled.description: Enable automatic maximum bandwidth calculation based on interface bandwidth.

ipSecSuiteB.description: IPsec Suite B cryptographic algorithm selection. When using gcm/gmac options, related IKE and IPsec algorithms must match the suite requirements. Invalid values default to 'none'.

presharedKey.description: Pre-shared key for IKE authentication. Leave empty to use AWS-generated keys.

ikeAuthenticationAlgorithm.description: IKE Phase 1 authentication algorithm for integrity verification.

ikeEncryptionAlgorithm.description: IKE Phase 1 encryption algorithm for key exchange protection.

ikePrf.description: IKE Pseudo-Random Function algorithm. Use 'auto' for automatic selection. Invalid values default to 'auto'.

dhgroup.description: Diffie-Hellman group for key exchange. Higher numbers provide stronger security.

ikeLifetime.description: IKE Phase 1 SA lifetime in minutes. AWS supports 0-480 minutes (0-28800 seconds). Value of 0 uses AWS default (28800 seconds / 8 hours).

dpdDelay.description: Dead Peer Detection delay interval in seconds. Time between DPD keepalive messages.

dpdRetry.description: Dead Peer Detection retry count. Number of retries before declaring peer dead.

idType.description: IKE identifier type for peer authentication.

idStr.description: IKE identifier string value. Used when idType is not 'address'.

exchangeMode.description: IKE Phase 1 exchange mode. 'aggressive' is required for AWS compatibility.

ikeVersion.description: IKE protocol version. AWS TGNM integration requires IKEv2 only. This field is mandatory.

ikeIdFormat.description: Format string for local IKE identifier generation.

remoteIkeIdFormat.description: Format string for remote IKE identifier expectation.

authenticationAlgorithm.description: IPsec Phase 2 authentication algorithm for packet integrity.

encryptionAlgorithm.description: IPsec Phase 2 encryption algorithm for data protection.

ipsecAntiReplayWindow.description: IPsec anti-replay window size. 'disable' turns off anti-replay protection.

lifebytes.description: IPsec SA lifetime in kilobytes. Volume-based rekeying threshold.

lifetime.description: IPsec Phase 2 SA lifetime in minutes. AWS supports 15-60 minutes (900-3600 seconds). This field is validated and must be within range.

pfs.description: Enable Perfect Forward Secrecy for IPsec Phase 2. Generates new keys for each session.

pfsgroup.description: Perfect Forward Secrecy Diffie-Hellman group. Only used when pfs is enabled.

ikePqcGroup.description: IKE Post-Quantum Cryptography key-exchange group. '0' disables PQC key exchange; otherwise must be one of the PQC groups allowed by the active cipher profile.

ipsecPqcGroup.description: IPsec Post-Quantum Cryptography key-exchange group. '0' disables PQC key exchange; otherwise must be one of the PQC groups allowed by the active cipher profile.

endEntityCertificate.description: Label of the End Entity Certificate profile used for Peer Authentication when peerAuthModes includes 1 (certificate-based authentication).

peerAuthModes.description: Peer authentication modes for IKEv2. 0=Pre-shared Key, 1=End Entity Certificate. Defaults to Pre-shared Key only.

ppkMandatory.description: When true, a Post-quantum Pre-Shared Key (PPK) is required for IKEv2 key exchange.

edgeConnectSegments.description: List of EdgeConnect segment IDs associated with this tunnel setting. AWS-specific extension for multi-segment support.

AwsTransitGatewayCoreNetworkAssociationE.description: Represents an association between an SD-WAN appliance and AWS Transit Gateways/Core Network Edges

priority.description: Priority level for orchestration. Set to 1 if TGW or CNE associations exist, otherwise 0. Higher priority appliances are processed first.

tgwTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when TGW association was last modified

cneTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when Core Network Edge association was last modified

tgwId.description: List of AWS Transit Gateway IDs associated with this appliance. Format: tgw-{17-character-hex-string}

coreNetworkEdgeId.description: List of AWS Cloud WAN Core Network Edge IDs associated with this appliance

AwsTransitGatewayCoreNetworkAssociationP.description: Request entity for creating or updating an appliance-to-AWS association. Only nePk is required; tgwId and coreNetworkEdgeId default to empty arrays. Priority and timestamps are auto-calculated by the server.

tgwId.description: List of AWS Transit Gateway IDs to associate. Empty array removes TGW associations. Format: tgw-{17-character-hex-string}

coreNetworkEdgeId.description: List of AWS Cloud WAN Core Network Edge IDs to associate. Empty array removes CNE associations.

AwsUIEntry.description: Represents an AWS configuration entry for an appliance's integration with AWS Transit Gateway or Cloud Network Edge.

interface_label.description: The interface label name on the appliance used for the AWS connection (e.g., WAN1, LAN0).

mode.description: The operational mode of the configuration entry.

segmentId.description: The numeric identifier of the network segment associated with this configuration.

segmentName.description: The human-readable name of the network segment.

awsArtifactName.description: The name of the AWS resource (Transit Gateway or Core Network Edge).

awsArtifactId.description: The unique AWS identifier for the resource. Format: 'tgw-*' for Transit Gateways, 'cne-*' for Core Network Edges.

awsRegion.description: The AWS region where the resource is located.

labelType.description: The type of interface label (WAN or LAN).

isCne.description: Indicates if the configuration is for a Cloud Network Edge (true) or Transit Gateway (false).

AwsVpcArtifacts.description: AWS VPC artifact containing VPC details and associated route tables

vpcId.description: AWS VPC identifier. Format: vpc-[17 alphanumeric characters]

vpcName.description: Human-readable VPC name from AWS tags

ownerId.description: AWS account ID that owns the VPC. 12-digit number.

routeTableArtifactMap.description: Map of route table IDs to route table artifacts

AwsVtiSubnetPoolEntry.description: Represents a VTI (Virtual Tunnel Interface) subnet entry in the AWS TGNM global subnet pool. Each entry defines a /30 subnet used for point-to-point VPN tunnel connections.

subnet.description: The base IP address of the VTI subnet (typically a /30 network). Used for the inside tunnel IP addressing.

mask.description: The subnet mask in CIDR notation (number of bits). Typically '30' for point-to-point tunnel connections.

labelID.description: The interface label identifier (e.g., wan0, wan1) indicating which WAN interface is used for the tunnel.

vtiInterface.description: The VTI interface name on the appliance (e.g., vti1, vti2) used for this tunnel connection.

reserved.description: Indicates whether this subnet is currently reserved (in use) or available for allocation. True means the subnet is assigned to an active tunnel.

remotePublicIP.description: The public IP address of the remote AWS Transit Gateway endpoint for the VPN tunnel.

awsID.description: The AWS resource identifier for the Transit Gateway attachment or related AWS resource.

segment.description: The network segment ID (VRF/VPN segment) this subnet is associated with. Segment 0 is typically the default segment.

AxisApplianceAssociations.description: Container object for HPE SSE (Axis) appliance associations. Used for both GET responses and POST request bodies.

enabled.description: Array of appliances enabled for HPE SSE integration. Duplicate nePk entries are merged automatically.

AxisIPSLARule.description: HPE SSE IPSLA rule destination configuration. Extends base IpslaRuleDestination with sourceInterface field specific to Axis/HPE SSE integration.

sourceInterface.description: WAN interface label to use as source for IPSLA probes. Must match a configured interface label. Empty string uses system default.

type.description: IPSLA monitor type. 'http-monitor' sends HTTP requests to destination URL; 'ip-monitor' sends ICMP probes to destination IP.

destination.description: Target destination for IPSLA probes. Required field that cannot be empty. For http-monitor use full URL; for ip-monitor use IP address. Multiple destinations can be comma-separated.

proxyAddress.description: HTTP proxy server hostname or IP for http-monitor probes. Leave empty for direct connection without proxy.

proxyPort.description: HTTP proxy server port number. Only used when proxyAddress is configured.

userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent header for HTTP monitor requests. Leave empty for default User-Agent.

httpTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP monitor requests before marking probe as failed.

keepAliveInterval.description: Interval in seconds between consecutive probe packets for health monitoring.

upThreshold.description: Number of consecutive successful probes required to mark path as UP after being DOWN.

downThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failed probes required to mark path as DOWN after being UP.

interval.description: IPSLA rule evaluation interval in seconds for calculating path health metrics.

samplingWindow.description: Rolling average window in seconds for calculating loss and latency metrics.

upLoss.description: Maximum packet loss percentage threshold for path to remain UP. Set 0 to disable loss-based monitoring.

downLoss.description: Packet loss percentage threshold at which path is marked DOWN. Set 0 to disable loss-based monitoring.

upLatency.description: Maximum latency in milliseconds for path to remain UP. Set 0 to disable latency-based monitoring.

downLatency.description: Latency threshold in milliseconds at which path is marked DOWN. Set 0 to disable latency-based monitoring.

metricCombination.description: Logical operator for combining loss and latency thresholds. 'metric-or' triggers state change when either condition is met; 'metric-and' requires both conditions.

routeLabelId.description: Route label ID to associate with this IPSLA rule for traffic steering. Use 0 for default route label.

AxisSubLocation.description: Sub-location traffic selection criteria based on LAN configuration.

lanSubnet.description: List of LAN subnet CIDR ranges to include in this sub-location.

lanLabel.description: List of interface label IDs to include in this sub-location.

lanZone.description: List of LAN firewall zone IDs to include in this sub-location.

addressGroup.description: List of address group names to include in this sub-location.

AxisSubLocationAppliance.description: Appliance selection criteria for the sub-location configuration.

all.description: When true, applies this sub-location to all appliances. Overrides region, group, and nePk selections.

region.description: List of region IDs to include. Appliances in these regions will use this sub-location.

group.description: List of group IDs to include. Appliances in these groups will use this sub-location.

nePk.description: List of specific appliance NePK identifiers to include in this sub-location.

AxisSubLocationConfig.description: HPE SSE sub-location configuration that maps appliances to sub-locations for traffic steering.

id.description: Unique identifier for this sub-location configuration. Auto-assigned when creating new configurations.

subLocationName.description: Name identifying this sub-location under each HPE SSE location. Must be unique within the location.

appliance.description: Appliance selection criteria specifying which appliances this sub-location applies to.

subLocation.description: Sub-location criteria specifying LAN subnets, interface labels, firewall zones, or address groups.

invalidRule.description: Indicates if the configuration is invalid. True when appliance or sub-location criteria are empty.

AxisSubscription.description: HPE SSE (Security Service Edge) subscription configuration for integrating with the HPE SSE service (formerly Axis Security).

apiTokenName.description: Identifier name for the API token used for HPE SSE authentication.

apiTokenKey.description: API token key for HPE SSE authentication. Always null in GET responses for security. Required only when creating a new subscription.
apiTokenKey.x-security-note: This field is encrypted at rest and never returned in GET responses

apiDomainName.description: HPE SSE API domain name for service connectivity. Must be a valid domain format.

fqdnDomainName.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name for HPE SSE service access. Must be a valid domain format.

orchestratorName.description: Name of the Orchestrator instance associated with this subscription.

x-validation-notes: apiTokenKey is required when creating a new subscription
apiTokenKey can be omitted when updating an existing subscription to keep the current key
apiDomainName and fqdnDomainName must be valid domain name formats

AxisVpnSubLocationPopConfig.description: HPE SSE site configuration and status information for an appliance.

labelId.description: Interface label identifier used for HPE SSE tunnel configuration.

tunnelId.description: Unique identifier for the HPE SSE VPN tunnel.

locationName.description: HPE SSE location name configured for this site.

sublocations.description: List of sublocations configured within this HPE SSE site.

popIps.description: Comma-separated list of user-configured POP (Point of Presence) override IP addresses.

AzureApplianceAssociationObject.description: Represents the association between an EdgeConnect appliance and Azure LAN-side resources (Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, Load Balancers) for SD-WAN orchestration.

priority.description: Priority value for the association. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used when multiple appliances are associated with the same Azure resource.

vhub_id.description: Array of Azure Virtual Hub resource IDs. Associates the appliance with Virtual Hubs for BGP peering and VNet connectivity. Orchestration creates VNet connections and BGP peers.

items.description: Azure Resource Manager ID for a Virtual Hub

routeserver_id.description: Array of Azure Route Server resource IDs. Associates the appliance with Route Servers for BGP peering. Orchestration configures BGP connections and static routes on the appliance.

items.description: Azure Resource Manager ID for a Route Server

loadbalancer_id.description: Array of Azure Internal Load Balancer resource IDs. Associates the appliance with Load Balancers for health probing. Orchestration adds appliance IPs to backend pools and configures static routes.

items.description: Azure Resource Manager ID for an Internal Load Balancer

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the association was last modified. Automatically updated when saving associations.

AzureArtifactApplianceConfig.description: Specifies which appliances this rule applies to. Use nePk for specific appliances, group for appliance groups, region for overlay regions, or set all to true for all appliances. Only one targeting method should be used per rule.

nePk.description: List of specific appliance identifiers (NE PKs) this rule applies to. Empty array if not targeting specific appliances.

group.description: List of appliance group IDs this rule applies to. All appliances in these groups will be affected.

region.description: List of overlay region IDs this rule applies to. All appliances in these regions will be affected.

all.description: When true, this rule applies to all appliances. Takes precedence over nePk, group, and region fields.

AzureConfigurationObject.description: Defines an association rule between EdgeConnect appliances and Azure LAN-side infrastructure including VNet, resource group, and region.

id.description: Unique identifier for the configuration rule. Use 0 for new rules; existing IDs are used for updates.

ruleName.description: Human-readable name for the configuration rule. Used for identification in the UI and logs.

azureRegion.description: Azure region identifier where resources are located (e.g., eastus, westus2, centralus).

azureResourceGroup.description: Name of the Azure Resource Group containing the VNet and related resources.

azureVnet.description: Full Azure Resource ID of the Virtual Network for LAN-side connectivity. Format: /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroup}/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/{vnetName}

AzureConnectivity.description: Response object containing the Azure VWAN connectivity status.

connectivity.description: The connectivity status to Azure VWAN. Value is derived from the AzureConnectivity enum.

x-enum-descriptions.0: NOT_CONNECTED - Unable to connect to Azure VWAN due to wrong credentials, timeout, or other errors
x-enum-descriptions.1: CONNECTED - Successfully connected to Azure VWAN using configured subscription

AzureInterfacesIdHolder.description: Container object for Azure LAN interface label configuration.

ids.description: Two-dimensional array: [primaryInterfaceLabels, backupInterfaceLabels]. Backup interfaces (index 1) are not currently supported.

items.description: Index 0: primary interface label IDs. Index 1: backup interface label IDs (reserved, pass empty array).
Interface label ID string matching a configured label in Orchestrator.

AzureInterfacesResponse.description: Two-dimensional array of interface label IDs. First inner array contains primary interface labels in priority order; second array is reserved for backup interfaces (currently unused). Returns empty array if no configuration exists.

items.description: Array of interface label IDs in priority order.
Interface label ID as a string. Must correspond to a valid interface label configured in the system.

AzureLanConfigurationObject.description: Represents an Azure LAN-side connectivity configuration entry that maps an appliance interface to an Azure resource (vHub, Route Server, or Load Balancer)

interface_label.description: Interface label identifier assigned to the LAN interface on the appliance (e.g., 'lan0', 'lan1')

labelType.description: Type of interface label. Typically 'LAN' for LAN-side connectivity configurations.

azureArtifactId.description: Full Azure Resource Manager (ARM) resource ID of the Azure artifact (vHub, Route Server, or Load Balancer)

azureArtifactName.description: Display name of the Azure resource extracted from the Azure Artifact ID

azureRegion.description: Azure region where the resource is deployed (e.g., 'eastus', 'westus', 'centralus')

resourceType.description: Type of Azure resource associated with this configuration

AzureLanInterfacesResponse.description: Two-dimensional array containing interface label configurations. The first sub-array contains primary interface label IDs, and the second sub-array contains backup interface label IDs (currently not supported).

items.description: Array of interface label IDs. Index 0 = primary interfaces, Index 1 = backup interfaces.
Interface label ID as a string. Must correspond to a valid interface label configured in the system.

AzureLanSideConnectionArtifact.description: Represents the BGP connection status for an Azure LAN-side integration artifact (Virtual Hub or Route Server).

interface_label.description: The appliance interface label used for the Azure LAN-side automation BGP connection.

azure_id.description: The full Azure resource ID of the Virtual Hub or Route Server to which the appliance is associated.

azure_name.description: The name of the Azure artifact (Virtual Hub or Route Server) to which the appliance is associated. Defaults to '{}' if not available.

bgpStatus.description: Map of Azure virtual router IP addresses to their individual BGP peer states. Contains status for each BGP peer connection.

additionalProperties.description: BGP peer state value (e.g., 'Established', 'Active', 'Connect', 'Idle').

connectionStatus.description: The overall aggregated BGP connection status computed from individual peer states.

AzureLanSideConnectivityResponse.description: Azure LAN-side connectivity status for Virtual Hub, Route Server, and Load Balancer resources.

vwanHub.description: Connectivity status for Azure Virtual WAN Hub. Tested via /providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualHubs API.

x-enum-descriptions.0: NOT_CONNECTED - Failed to connect due to wrong credentials, timeout, or general error
x-enum-descriptions.1: CONNECTED - Successfully connected to Azure Virtual Hub API
x-enum-descriptions.3: INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS - HTTP 403 returned, missing required Azure permissions

routeServer.description: Connectivity status for Azure Route Server. Tested via /providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualHubs API.

x-enum-descriptions.0: NOT_CONNECTED - Failed to connect due to wrong credentials, timeout, or general error
x-enum-descriptions.1: CONNECTED - Successfully connected to Azure Route Server API
x-enum-descriptions.3: INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS - HTTP 403 returned, missing required Azure permissions

loadBalancer.description: Connectivity status for Azure Load Balancer. Tested via /providers/Microsoft.Network/loadBalancers API.

x-enum-descriptions.0: NOT_CONNECTED - Failed to connect due to wrong credentials, timeout, or general error
x-enum-descriptions.1: CONNECTED - Successfully connected to Azure Load Balancer API
x-enum-descriptions.3: INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS - HTTP 403 returned, missing required Azure permissions

AzureLanSidePauseOrchestration.description: Configuration object for Azure LAN Side Connectivity orchestration pause state.

paused.description: When true, orchestration is paused and appliances are queued. When false, orchestration is active and processes appliances.

AzureLanSideSubscriptionObject.description: Azure LAN-side subscription account configuration for SD-WAN cloud integration with Virtual Hubs, Route Servers, and Load Balancers.

id.description: Reference to an existing Azure cloud deployment account ID. The clientSecret is retrieved from this account.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the Azure subscription account. Used for identification in the UI.

subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID (GUID format). Found in Azure Portal under Subscriptions.

tenantId.description: Azure Active Directory tenant ID (GUID format). Found in Azure Portal under Azure Active Directory > Properties.

clientId.description: Azure AD application (service principal) client ID. The app must have Network Contributor permissions.

clientSecret.description: Azure AD application client secret. Not required in POST (retrieved from existing account); always null in GET responses.

comment.description: Optional notes or description for this Azure subscription configuration.
comment.example: Azure subscription for LAN-side connectivity automation

AzureLoadBalancerObject.description: Represents an Azure Load Balancer resource with its frontend and backend configurations for LAN-side connectivity orchestration.

loadBalancerId.description: The full Azure resource ID of the load balancer. Used as unique identifier for appliance association.

loadBalancerName.description: The display name of the load balancer extracted from the resource ID.

location.description: The Azure region where the load balancer is deployed.

lBFrontEndIpConfigList.description: List of frontend IP configurations associated with this load balancer.

lBBackendAddressPoolsList.description: List of backend address pools configured on this load balancer for traffic distribution.

AzureRegionsMap.description: A mapping of Azure region identifiers to their human-readable display names. Keys are Azure region IDs (e.g., 'eastus'), values are display names with geographic context (e.g., '(US) East US').

additionalProperties.description: Regional display name including geographic prefix in parentheses

AzureRouteServerObject.description: Represents an Azure Route Server resource that enables dynamic routing between network appliances and Azure virtual networks.

routeServerId.description: The full Azure Resource Manager ID for the Route Server. Used to uniquely identify the resource within Azure.

routeServerName.description: The display name of the Azure Route Server. Extracted from the resource ID for easier identification.

location.description: The Azure region where the Route Server is deployed (e.g., eastus, westus2, centralus).

virtualRouterAsn.description: The Autonomous System Number (ASN) assigned to the Route Server for BGP peering. Azure typically uses ASN 65515.

virtualRouterIps.description: Array of IP addresses assigned to the Route Server for BGP peering. Used by appliances to establish BGP sessions.

items.description: Individual IP address of a Route Server BGP endpoint.

AzureSubscription.description: Azure Virtual WAN subscription configuration for Orchestrator integration. All fields are required when creating or updating a subscription.

subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID (GUID format). Identifies the Azure subscription containing Virtual WAN resources.

tenantId.description: Azure Active Directory tenant ID (GUID format). Identifies the Azure AD tenant for authentication.

clientId.description: Azure AD application (service principal) client ID. Used for API authentication with Azure.

clientSecret.description: Azure AD application client secret key. Required for authentication; not returned in GET responses.

storageAccountName.description: Azure Storage account name for VPN configuration storage. Must be globally unique.

storageAccountKey.description: Azure Storage account access key. Required for blob access; not returned in GET responses.

blobUrlLocation.description: Azure Blob Storage URL for VPN site configuration files. Format: https://{account}.blob.core.windows.net/{container}

AzureSubscriptionResponse.description: Azure subscription configuration returned by GET. Sensitive fields (clientSecret, storageAccountKey) are always null for security.

subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID (GUID format). Identifies the Azure subscription containing Virtual WAN resources.

tenantId.description: Azure Active Directory tenant ID (GUID format). Identifies the Azure AD tenant for authentication.

clientId.description: Azure AD application (service principal) client ID. Used for API authentication with Azure.

clientSecret.description: Always null in GET responses. Client secret is never exposed for security.

storageAccountName.description: Azure Storage account name for VPN configuration storage.

storageAccountKey.description: Always null in GET responses. Storage key is never exposed for security.

blobUrlLocation.description: Azure Blob Storage URL for VPN site configuration files.

AzureTgnmVtiCidr.description: VTI IP Pool configuration settings for Azure vWAN tunnel interface subnet allocation

ipAddress.description: Subnet IP address for the VTI global pool. Must be a valid IPv4 network address.

mask.description: Subnet mask in CIDR notation (number of bits). Valid range is 8 to 32.

AzureVWanConfigurationEntry.description: Represents an Azure Virtual WAN VPN Site configuration entry for an appliance interface.

interface_label.description: Appliance interface label used to create the Azure VPN Site connection.

pre_shared_key.description: Pre-shared key (PSK) used for IPSec tunnel authentication between the appliance and Azure.

pre_shared_key_time_stamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the pre-shared key was created or last updated.

azure_site_id.description: Azure resource ID of the VPN Site. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

azure_vpn_configuration_download.description: JSON string containing the downloaded Azure VPN configuration. Defaults to '{}' if not available.

azure_vpn_configuration_download_time_st.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the VPN configuration was last downloaded from Azure. Defaults to '{}' if never downloaded.

status.description: Current provisioning status of the VPN Site in Azure.

AzureVWanConnectionArtifact.description: Azure VWAN VPN connection status details including BGP peer state information.

interface_label.description: The appliance interface label used to create the Azure VWAN VPN connection.

siteId.description: Azure VPN Site resource ID to which the VPN connection is established. Returns '{}' if not configured.

bgpStatus.description: Map of BGP peer IP addresses to their current state (e.g., 'Established', 'Connect', 'Active').

connectionStatus.description: Overall VPN connection BGP status. Possible values: 'Established' (all peers up), 'Partial' (some peers up), 'Down' (no peers up), 'Unreachable' (appliance unreachable).

AzurelBBackendAddressPoolObject.description: Backend address pool configuration containing target endpoints for load-balanced traffic.

backendAddressName.description: The name of the backend address pool.

backendAddressId.description: The full Azure resource ID of the backend address pool.

ClearPassAccount.description: ClearPass Policy Manager account credentials and settings stored within configData.

name.description: Unique user-defined name for the ClearPass account.

domain.description: IP address or hostname of the ClearPass Policy Manager server.

clientId.description: OAuth2 API client ID for authenticating with ClearPass Policy Manager.

accessKey.description: OAuth2 API access key (client secret) for authentication. This field is always null in GET responses for security.

verifyCert.description: Whether to verify the SSL certificate when connecting to ClearPass Policy Manager.

ClearPassAccountMap.description: Map of ClearPass accounts keyed by their integer ID. Returned when no specific ID is requested.

ClearPassConfiguration.description: Represents a ClearPass Policy Manager configuration with connection and service status information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ClearPass configuration.

name.description: User-defined name for the ClearPass Policy Manager configuration. Must be unique across all configurations.

domain.description: IP address or hostname of the ClearPass Policy Manager server. Can be an IPv4 address or a valid URL.

configData.description: JSON-encoded string containing the ClearPass account details including name, domain, clientId, and verifyCert. The accessKey is masked for security.

serviceInfo.description: JSON-encoded string containing service endpoint status for contextServer, loginContextServerAction, and logoutContextServerAction.

status.description: Connection status to the ClearPass server. Values: 0=CONNECTING, 1=CONNECTED, 2=AUTH_FAILED, 3=UNREACHABLE, 4=PAUSED, 5=FAILED.

paused.description: Indicates whether the ClearPass configuration is paused. When true, no events are processed for this account.

needService.description: Internal flag indicating if the account needs service operations to be performed.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last configuration update.

ClearPassConnectivityResponse.description: Response containing the connectivity status to a ClearPass Policy Manager account.

connectivity.description: Connection status code indicating the result of the connectivity test.

x-enum-descriptions.1: CONNECTED - Successfully authenticated with CPPM
x-enum-descriptions.3: UNREACHABLE - Cannot reach CPPM server (timeout or network error)

ClearPassEventLog.description: Represents a ClearPass Policy Manager authentication event log entry containing user session and device information.

startTime.description: Session start time as epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Derived from the event timestamp.

endTime.description: Session end time as epoch timestamp in milliseconds. Value is 0 for active sessions without logout.

timestamp.description: Original ClearPass event timestamp in 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' format.

ipAddress.description: Client device IP address assigned during the session.

cppmDomain.description: IP address or hostname of the ClearPass Policy Manager server that processed the event.

username.description: Authenticated username associated with the session.

deviceOS.description: Operating system of the client device as identified by ClearPass.

roles.description: Comma-separated list of user roles assigned by ClearPass Policy Manager.

ssid.description: Wireless network SSID the device connected to, if applicable.

authProtocol.description: Authentication protocol used for the session (e.g., EAP-TLS, PEAP, MAB).

posture.description: Device health/posture status as determined by ClearPass endpoint compliance checks.

mac.description: MAC address of the client device in colon-separated format.

locationId.description: Network access point or location identifier where the device connected.

otherInfo.description: Additional event attributes in JSON format that don't map to standard fields.

ClearPassPauseOrchestration.description: Pause state configuration for ClearPass Policy Manager orchestration. Controls event processing and synchronization.

paused.description: When true, orchestration is paused and login/logout events are not processed. When false, orchestration is active and events are processed.

x-behaviors.whenPaused: All ClearPass accounts are marked as paused. Login/logout events from CPPM are not processed.
x-behaviors.whenResumed: Full sync is triggered via setAllNeedService(). All configurations are refreshed to ensure synchronization.

ClearPassUsernameAndRoleMap.description: Response object containing lists of usernames and roles associated with the queried IP address and time range.

items.description: Username associated with the IP address during the specified time range.

roles.description: List of roles from ClearPass event logs matching the query criteria. May contain duplicates if multiple events exist.

items.description: Role assigned to the user during the authentication event.

subLocation.description: Sub-location name under the parent location. Present only for sub-location entries.

ipAddresses.description: IP ranges for LAN subnets. Present only for sub-location entries.

items.description: IP range in CIDR notation.

x-enum-descriptions.0: NOT_CONNECTED - Unable to reach Netskope cloud services
x-enum-descriptions.1: CONNECTED - Successfully connected to Netskope cloud services

CoreNetworkSummary.description: AWS Core Network summary containing identification, ownership, and state information. Represents a Cloud Network Edge resource.

tags.description: List of AWS tags attached to the Core Network for organization and identification.

additionalProperties.description: The display name of the AWS Global Network.

Interface label ID as a string.

IpslaRuleDestination.description: Base IP SLA rule destination configuration for tunnel health monitoring. Uses ICMP or HTTP probes to determine tunnel status.

sourceInterface.description: Source interface label for IP SLA probes. Identifies which WAN interface sends monitoring traffic.

type.description: Monitor type. Defaults to 'ip-monitor' (ICMP). Use 'http-monitor' for HTTP-based checks.

destination.description: Required. Comma-separated destination IP addresses or hostnames for probe targets. Whitespace is trimmed automatically.

proxyAddress.description: Proxy server address for HTTP monitoring. Only used when type is 'http-monitor'.

proxyPort.description: Proxy server port. Required when proxyAddress is set. Range: 1-65535.

userAgent.description: HTTP User-Agent header for HTTP monitoring requests. Only used when type is 'http-monitor'.

httpTimeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Only used when type is 'http-monitor'. Must be positive.

keepAliveInterval.description: Probe frequency in seconds. Controls how often connectivity checks are performed.

upThreshold.description: Consecutive successful probes required to mark tunnel UP. Higher values provide stability.

downThreshold.description: Consecutive failed probes required to mark tunnel DOWN. Higher values prevent false positives.

interval.description: Time interval in seconds between IP SLA rule evaluations.

samplingWindow.description: Rolling window size in seconds for calculating loss and latency metrics.

upLoss.description: Packet loss percentage threshold for UP state. Tunnel is UP when loss is below this value.

downLoss.description: Packet loss percentage threshold for DOWN state. Tunnel is DOWN when loss exceeds this value.

upLatency.description: Latency threshold in milliseconds for UP state. Tunnel is UP when latency is below this value.

downLatency.description: Latency threshold in milliseconds for DOWN state. Tunnel is DOWN when latency exceeds this value.

metricCombination.description: Logic for combining loss and latency metrics. 'Loss OR Latency' triggers on either; 'Loss AND Latency' requires both.

routeLabelId.description: Route label ID for traffic steering. Value 0 means default routing (no specific label).

IpslaSetting.title: HPE SSE IP SLA Setting
IpslaSetting.description: Configuration object for HPE SSE (Axis) IP SLA rule orchestration. Controls automatic IP SLA rule deployment on SD-WAN appliances.

enableIpslaRuleOrchestration.description: Controls automatic IP SLA rule orchestration for HPE SSE. When true, IP SLA rules are automatically configured on appliances.

LanSidePollingIntervalResponse.description: Response containing the Azure LAN-side connectivity polling interval configuration

lanSidePollingInterval.description: The polling interval in seconds for fetching Azure LAN-side connectivity resources (Virtual WAN Hub, Route Server, Load Balancer). Default is 14400 seconds (4 hours).

NetskopeApplianceAssociation.description: Appliance association entity stored in database. Maps to NetskopeApplianceAssociation Java entity.

priority.description: Polling priority level. Value 1 selects this appliance for Netskope polling tasks. Only one appliance should have priority=1.

lastUpdateTime.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) of last update. System sets this value when priority is reset.

NetskopeApplianceAssociationInput.description: Input schema for creating/updating appliance association. Only nePk is required.

priority.description: Set to 1 to designate as high-priority polling appliance. Default is 0 (normal priority).

lastUpdateTime.description: Optional Unix timestamp (milliseconds). System updates this automatically on changes.

NetskopeApplianceAssociations.description: Request body for saving Netskope appliance associations. Duplicates by nePk are automatically removed.

enabled.description: Array of appliances to associate with Netskope. Pass empty array to clear all associations.

NetskopeApplianceAssociationsResponse.description: Response containing appliances associated with Netskope. Returns stored configuration from GMS database.

enabled.description: Array of appliance associations. Empty array indicates no appliances are associated.

NetskopeConfigurationEntry.description: Netskope tunnel and orchestration configuration for an appliance interface.

labelId.description: Interface label identifier for the tunnel configuration.

ipsecTunnelId.description: JSON string containing IPsec tunnel identifiers. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

ipsecTunnelConfig.description: JSON string containing IPsec tunnel configuration settings. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

ipsecPops.description: JSON string containing IPsec Points of Presence (POPs) information. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

greTunnelId.description: JSON string containing GRE tunnel identifiers. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

greTunnelConfig.description: JSON string containing GRE tunnel configuration settings. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

grePops.description: JSON string containing GRE Points of Presence (POPs) information. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

preSharedKey.description: JSON string containing encrypted pre-shared key for tunnel authentication. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

preSharedKeyTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the pre-shared key was last updated. Defaults to current time if not set.

ipsecTunnelLastUpdatedTimeStamp.description: Timestamp when the IPsec tunnel configuration was last updated. Defaults to current time if not set.

greTunnelLastupdatedTimeStamp.description: Timestamp when the GRE tunnel configuration was last updated. Defaults to current time if not set.

nextModeChange.description: JSON string containing scheduled next mode change information. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

modeChange.description: JSON string containing current mode change status. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

serviceEdgeOverride.description: JSON string containing Netskope service edge override settings. Defaults to '{}' if not configured.

serviceEdgeOverrideUpdatedTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the service edge override was last updated. Defaults to current time if not set.

NetskopeIPSLARuleDestination.description: Configuration for Netskope IP SLA (Service Level Agreement) rule destination. Defines monitoring parameters for tunnel health checks to Netskope service edges. Extends the base IpslaRuleDestination with a sourceInterface field specific to Netskope.

sourceInterface.description: The WAN interface label used as the source for IPSLA probes. Must match a configured interface label on the appliance. If not specified, may trigger a NETSKOPE_IPSLA_SOURCE_INTERFACE_MISSING alarm.

type.description: The type of IP SLA monitor. For Netskope integration, only 'ip-monitor' (ICMP ping) is supported. This value is validated on POST and will reject non-ip-monitor types.

destination.description: The destination IP address or hostname for IPSLA probes. For Netskope, this field should be left null/empty as the destination is dynamically generated based on Netskope POP (Point of Presence) endpoints.

proxyAddress.description: HTTP proxy server address for HTTP-based monitoring. Not applicable for Netskope ip-monitor type.

proxyPort.description: HTTP proxy server port number for HTTP-based monitoring. Not applicable for Netskope ip-monitor type.

userAgent.description: User-Agent header for HTTP-based monitoring. Not applicable for Netskope ip-monitor type.

httpTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP-based monitoring requests. Not applicable for Netskope ip-monitor type.

keepAliveInterval.description: The polling frequency in seconds between IPSLA probes. Determines how often the appliance sends ICMP ping probes to the Netskope service edge.

upThreshold.description: Number of consecutive successful probes required to mark a tunnel as UP. The tunnel transitions to UP state after this many successful responses.

downThreshold.description: Number of consecutive failed probes required to mark a tunnel as DOWN. The tunnel transitions to DOWN state after this many failed responses.

interval.description: The interval in seconds for the IPSLA rule execution cycle. Controls the overall timing of the monitoring process.

samplingWindow.description: The time window in seconds for calculating rolling average metrics for loss and latency. Metrics are averaged over this period for threshold comparisons.

upLoss.description: Packet loss percentage threshold for marking tunnel as UP. When loss drops below this percentage within the sampling window, the tunnel is considered healthy.

downLoss.description: Packet loss percentage threshold for marking tunnel as DOWN. When loss exceeds this percentage within the sampling window, the tunnel is considered unhealthy.

upLatency.description: Latency threshold in milliseconds for marking tunnel as UP. When latency drops below this value within the sampling window, the tunnel is considered healthy.

downLatency.description: Latency threshold in milliseconds for marking tunnel as DOWN. When latency exceeds this value within the sampling window, the tunnel is considered unhealthy.

metricCombination.description: Logical operator for combining loss and latency thresholds. 'OR' means either condition triggers state change, 'AND' means both conditions must be met.

routeLabelId.description: The route label ID to associate with this IPSLA rule for traffic routing decisions. Value 0 indicates no specific route label is used (default behavior).

NetskopeIpslaSetting.description: Configuration object for Netskope IP SLA (Service Level Agreement) orchestration settings. Controls automatic management of IP SLA monitoring rules for Netskope tunnels.

enableIpslaRuleOrchestration.description: Enables or disables automatic IP SLA rule orchestration for Netskope tunnels. When true, IP SLA rules are configured to monitor tunnel connectivity and health. Default is true for new installations.

PauseOrchestrationRequest.description: Request body for setting the pause state of Azure VWAN orchestration.

paused.description: Set to true to pause orchestration (stops automatic configuration). Set to false to resume orchestration (triggers a full sync for all affected appliances).

PauseOrchestrationState.description: Represents the current pause state of Azure VWAN orchestration.

paused.description: Indicates whether Azure VWAN orchestration is paused. When true, automatic VPN site creation, tunnel management, and BGP configuration are suspended.

PollingInterval.description: HPE SSE (Axis) polling interval configuration object containing the time interval in seconds between location data synchronization cycles.

pollingInterval.description: Time interval in seconds between HPE SSE location and sub-location data synchronization. Must be a positive integer. Default is 600 seconds (10 minutes).

PollingIntervalResponse.description: Response object containing the Zscaler polling interval configuration.

pollingInterval.description: Time gap in seconds between consecutive downloads of locations and sub-locations from the Zscaler Internet Access portal. Controls synchronization frequency for Zscaler location data.

PopOverride.description: Netskope service edge override configuration specifying custom primary and secondary service edge addresses for tunnel termination.

pop1.description: Primary service edge address. Must be a valid IPv4 address or FQDN domain name.

pop2.description: Secondary service edge address for failover. Must be a valid IPv4 address or FQDN domain name, and must differ from pop1.

PopOverrideLabelMap.description: Map of WAN interface label IDs to their respective POP override configurations for a single appliance.

remoteEndpointName.description: Display name for the remote endpoint. Must be unique within the service.

probeIpAddress.description: Probe IP address(es) for endpoint health monitoring. Use pipe (|) separator for multiple IPs.

backupEndpointId.description: ID of backup endpoint for failover configuration.

timestamp.description: Last modification timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

remoteEndpoints.description: Array of remote endpoint entries to add to the service provider.

RemoteEndpointResponse.description: Container for remote endpoint entries associated with a service provider.

remoteEndpoints.description: List of remote endpoint configurations for the service.

serviceId.description: Unique identifier of the service provider this configuration belongs to.

labelId.description: Appliance interface label identifier used for the connection.

labelType.description: Type of the interface label (e.g., wan, lan).

remoteEndpointId.description: Unique identifier of the primary remote endpoint.

remoteEndpointName.description: Display name of the primary remote endpoint.

backupEndpointId.description: Unique identifier of the backup remote endpoint (optional).

backupEndpointName.description: Display name of the backup remote endpoint (optional).

tunnelStatus.description: Current status of the tunnel connection.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the configuration was last updated.

ServiceOrchServiceProviderEntry.description: Configuration entry for a third-party service provider in Service Orchestration. Used to integrate cloud security services like Zscaler, Palo Alto, and Netskope with SD-WAN appliances.

serviceId.description: Auto-generated unique identifier for the service provider. Assigned by the system on creation.

serviceName.description: Human-readable display name of the service provider. Used in UI and action logs. Must be unique across all providers.

servicePrefix.description: Short prefix used for generating pass-through tunnel aliases and BIO policy names. Should be lowercase alphanumeric without spaces.

serviceIcon.description: Base64-encoded icon image data (PNG, JPG, etc.) for the service provider. Maximum size: 20MB. Used in UI displays.

serviceIconPath.description: Server-relative path to the stored icon image file. Auto-generated when serviceIcon is provided and bioBreakout is enabled.

bioBreakout.description: Business Intent Overlay (BIO) breakout feature. When enabled (1), traffic is steered through the third-party service. Auto-set to 1 on new provider creation.

pauseOrchestration.description: Orchestration pause status. When paused, tunnel configuration changes are not applied to appliances.

interfaces.description: JSON-encoded array of interface label breakout configuration. Format: [[primary_labels], [backup_labels]]. Labels define which WAN interfaces are used for tunnels.

tunnelSettings.description: JSON-encoded IPSec tunnel settings including IKE version, encryption algorithms, DPD settings, and authentication. Applied to all tunnels for this provider.

ipslaSettings.description: JSON-encoded IP SLA monitoring configuration for health-checking tunnels to this provider. Default settings auto-generated on creation.

timestamp.description: Last modification timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds. Updated automatically on any configuration change.

ServiceOrchestrationIpslaSetting.description: IP SLA settings for third-party service orchestration controlling monitoring enablement and configuration.

enableIpslaRuleOrchestration.description: Enable or disable IP SLA rule orchestration. When true, IP SLA rules are deployed to associated appliances.

thirdPartyIPSLARuleDestination.description: IP SLA monitoring rule configuration with probe destinations, timing, and health thresholds.

ServiceProviderBioBreakout.description: BIO Breakout state response for a service provider.

bioBreakout.description: BIO Breakout state: 1 = enabled (service provider is included in BIO Breakout Internet Policies), 0 = disabled (service provider is excluded from policies).

bioBreakout.description: Desired BIO Breakout state: 1 = enable (add service provider to BIO Breakout Internet Policies), 0 = disable (remove from policies).

items.description: Array of interface label IDs for building pass-through tunnels to the service provider.
Interface label ID as a string.

paused.description: Orchestration pause state. True stops tunnel operations; false resumes and triggers appliance sync.

items.description: Appliance identifier (nePk) - typically in the format IP_nePk or hostname_nePk

Subscription.description: Zscaler subscription configuration containing cloud connection and authentication details.

cloud.description: Zscaler cloud endpoint hostname for API communication.

username.description: Zscaler partner admin email address used for API authentication.

password.description: Zscaler partner admin password. Required on initial setup; optional for updates. Always returned empty in GET responses for security.

partnerKey.description: Zscaler third-party partner key provided by Zscaler for SilverPeak/Aruba integration.

enableZDX.description: Enables Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) monitoring integration. When true, zdxCloud is required.

zdxCloud.description: ZDX cloud endpoint hostname. Required when enableZDX is true.

key.description: Tag key name.

TgwAssociationList.description: List of appliance-to-AWS Transit Gateway and Core Network Edge associations

TgwAssociationPostRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating appliance associations. Only nePk is required; other fields are optional.

ThirdPartyIPSLARuleDestination.description: Configuration for IP SLA monitoring probes used to verify third-party tunnel connectivity. Extends base IPSLA settings with source interface specification. The destination field is required for POST operations.

sourceInterface.description: Source interface label for IPSLA probes. Must match a configured WAN interface label.

type.description: Monitor type for health probes. 'ip-monitor' uses ICMP ping; 'http-monitor' uses HTTP GET requests (requires appliance 9.0.3+).

destination.description: Required. Comma-separated list of probe destination addresses. Values are trimmed automatically. For ip-monitor: IP addresses (e.g., '8.8.8.8,8.8.4.4'). For http-monitor: URLs (e.g., 'http://www.example.com/test'). Cannot be empty.

proxyAddress.description: HTTP proxy server address for http-monitor type. Only applicable when type is 'http-monitor'.

proxyPort.description: HTTP proxy server port. Only used when proxyAddress is specified.

userAgent.description: Custom User-Agent header for HTTP probes. Only applicable for 'http-monitor' type.

httpTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP probe requests. Only applicable for 'http-monitor' type.

keepAliveInterval.description: Polling frequency in seconds for sending probe packets.

upThreshold.description: Consecutive successful probes needed to transition from DOWN to UP.

downThreshold.description: Consecutive failed probes needed to transition from UP to DOWN.

interval.description: Statistics reporting interval in seconds for loss/latency metrics.

samplingWindow.description: Rolling average window size in seconds for loss/latency statistics. Used with quality metrics.

upLoss.description: Max acceptable packet loss percentage for UP state. Triggers DOWN if exceeded (based on metricCombination).

downLoss.description: Packet loss percentage threshold indicating DOWN state.

upLatency.description: Max acceptable latency in milliseconds for UP state. Triggers DOWN if exceeded (based on metricCombination).

downLatency.description: Latency threshold in milliseconds indicating DOWN state.

metricCombination.description: Logical operator for loss/latency thresholds. 'or': transition if either exceeds; 'and': both must exceed.

routeLabelId.description: Route label identifier. 0 means no label; other values reference configured route labels.

ThirdPartyTunnelSetting.description: IPSec/GRE tunnel configuration for Zscaler integration

mode.description: Tunnel encapsulation mode: ipsec_ip (IPSec with IP), ipsec (IPSec), or gre (GRE)

autoMaxBandwidthEnabled.description: Enable automatic maximum bandwidth detection for the tunnel

ipSecSuiteB.description: NSA Suite B cryptographic compliance level

presharedKey.description: IKE pre-shared key for tunnel authentication. Required for IPSec modes.

ikePrf.description: IKE Pseudo-Random Function. Use 'auto' to match authentication algorithm.

ikeLifetime.description: IKE Phase 1 SA lifetime in seconds

dpdDelay.description: Dead Peer Detection delay interval in seconds

dpdRetry.description: Number of DPD retry attempts before declaring peer dead

idType.description: IKE identity type for Phase 1 authentication

idStr.description: IKE identity string value matching the selected idType

exchangeMode.description: IKEv1 Phase 1 exchange mode (only applicable when ikeVersion is 1)

ikeIdFormat.description: Local IKE ID format for identification

remoteIkeIdFormat.description: Expected remote peer IKE ID format

ipsecAntiReplayWindow.description: IPSec anti-replay window size in packets

lifebytes.description: IPSec SA lifetime in bytes (0 for unlimited)

lifetime.description: IPSec Phase 2 SA lifetime in seconds

pfs.description: Enable Perfect Forward Secrecy for Phase 2

pfsgroup.description: PFS Diffie-Hellman group (required when pfs is true)

ikePqcGroup.description: IKE Post-Quantum Cryptography key-exchange group. '0' disables PQC key exchange; otherwise must be one of the PQC groups allowed by the active cipher profile.

ipsecPqcGroup.description: IPsec Post-Quantum Cryptography key-exchange group. '0' disables PQC key exchange; otherwise must be one of the PQC groups allowed by the active cipher profile.

endEntityCertificate.description: Label of the End Entity Certificate profile used for Peer Authentication when peerAuthModes includes 1 (certificate-based authentication).

peerAuthModes.description: Peer authentication modes for IKEv2. 0=Pre-shared Key, 1=End Entity Certificate. Defaults to Pre-shared Key only.

exchangeMode.description: IKE Phase 1 exchange mode. Aggressive mode is faster but less secure than main mode.

authenticationAlgorithm.description: IPsec Phase 2 authentication (integrity) algorithm. Zscaler recommends sha256.

lifebytes.description: IPsec SA lifetime in megabytes. 0 means unlimited data volume before rekeying.

lifetime.description: IPsec Phase 2 SA lifetime in minutes. Determines how often IPsec keys are renegotiated.

pfs.description: Enable Perfect Forward Secrecy. When false, Phase 2 keys derive from Phase 1 keys.

pfsgroup.description: Perfect Forward Secrecy Diffie-Hellman group. Only used when pfs is enabled.

ikePqcGroup.description: IKE Post-Quantum Cryptography key-exchange group. '0' disables PQC key exchange; otherwise must be one of the PQC groups allowed by the active cipher profile.

ZscalerCountryMappings.description: Pipe-separated string of ISO Alpha-2 to Zscaler country mappings.
